cynthia mcclellan.name: Cynthia McClellan
cynthia mcclellan.origin: Cynthia was a nine-year-old tomboy from Citrusville, Florida, Cynthia admired Iron Man; thus, she obtained a costume similar to Iron Man Armor MK IV, which he sported at that time, and played with her friends Sanford and Boyd pretending to be "Iron Girl." Sanford happened to own the Molecule Man's Wand (which he was given by the Thing) after the apparent death of Owen Reece, the original Molecule Man. During a game, the wand fell in the Man-Thing's Swamp, especifically in a mutagenic area that had created the Glob. When Cynthia grabbed the wand, she drowned there only to come back sharing her body and mind with the Molecule Man, which turned her into the Molecule Person. Iron Man and the Man-Thing succeeded in making her drop the wand, turning her back into a little girl.
powers: As the Molecule Person, she had the powers of the Molecule Man for a while
weaknesses: Double personality, she could fight the Molecule Man's essence in her mind.

cynthia nicolson.name: Cynthia Nicolson
cynthia nicolson.origin: Cynthia Nicolson, known professionally as Madame Cynthia, was a medium who conducted séances alongside her son, Arnold Nicolson. Operating in New York, she presented herself as capable of contacting the spirits of the deceased for paying clients. During one such séance, held for members of the Carwell family in an attempt to reach the late David Carwell, the ritual took an unexpected turn. Rather than producing the intended result, an unknown force made contact with Arnold, overtaking him and transforming him into a primitive being identifying himself as Armak. The situation escalated rapidly, resulting in violence and the abduction of Anne Carwell. Madame Cynthia later followed the unfolding events to the scene of the confrontation, where she attempted to reach her son using a loudspeaker, appealing to his identity in an effort to break the influence controlling him. When Armak was momentarily distracted, Thor took the opportunity to punch him off the elevator, and Armak took the long fall down to the ground. Fatally wounded, Armak transformed back into Arnold who reached towards Anne and called her beautiful before dying.

cyra asgardian.name: Cyra (Asgardian)
cyra asgardian.origin: In Asgard, Odin and Cyra discovered that the Watcher had appeared among them, alerting them that they were at a crossroads of the future. If Thor defeated the Tarene-animated Destroyer, the future Reigning would come to pass and mankind would not evolve like it should. Jane and Thor arrived, and Odin called in his healers Cyra and Neffethesk. Cyra went to prepare the casts, but Neffethesk told her to wait, that his injuries would heal quicker if he would agree to be immersed in the Elixirs of Renewal. Odin agreed to enchant the Elixirs of Thor would agree to the treatment. In Oslo, the heroes gathered around the fallen form of Odin, and all of their fears came true. Thor flew to Asgard to fetch Neffethesk and Cyra to try and save him, but to no avail. Cyra discovered that Tarene was no longer the Designate, she was only left with the power of an Asgardian goddess. They all returned to Asgard to hold Odin's funeral, and Thor burned the Ring Imperial, sending the message out across the cosmos that Odin was no more.
abilities: Medicine

cyrus maldor.name: Cyrus Maldor
cyrus maldor.origin: Dr. Cyrus Maldor organized an expedition to some long lost Maya ruins several years before, but his credit for the discovery was stolen by the rest of the team and he was left the curator of the insignificant Drummond Musuem. This caused him to seek revenge as the crime lord known as the Scarab on each of the scientists. Using a deadly hypnotic chemical called the Purple Death, Dr. Maldor forced multiple members of the expedition crew to commit suicide, after robbing them of inventions or money. The mysterious Captain America cut off Maldor’s supply of the Purple Death, but not before the scientist Professor Lyman was compelled by the drug to reveal the blueprints for a thermodynamic vibration engine that could cause buildings to rip apart. Maldor caught wind however that there was a working model of the “Vibrator,” and it could expose his new secret weapon. The Scarab had one of his agents send a message to the DA’s office as a distraction, assuming it would make its way to Captain America. Captain America indeed was sent off the trail, while the Scarab’s men began to overload the model to shake its lab apart. However, Captain America came before the Vibrator could finish destroying the building, managing to rescue the staff as well as limit the destruction. ===Professor Dodge and the Fire Bolt=== Though the Scarab’s supply of the Purple Death was all but gone, he had enough to briefly mesmerized Gail Richards and have her arrange for him to kidnap Professor Dodge. Maldor had already acquired the plans for an Electronic Fire Bolt, and had his men force Dodge to decode them. Captain America rescued Dodge, but not before the Scarab had the plans. The Scarab’s men began a series of heists using the Fire Bolt, cutting through any safe. While the Scarab’s men were arrogant Maldor was more cautious, and had them investigate the DA’s plans. Learning that Professor Dodge was building a tracking device for the Fire Bolt, the Scarab had his men sabotage the DA’s car before he could acquire the last part. The DA survived, but the Scarab believed the tracker was inoperable. This proved to be in error, as in the next heist Captain America interrupted his gang, and captured the Fire Bolt and a remote control van used by the gang. Maldor attended the reading of a will for the late Professor Lyman, only to learn he had been snubbed once again, and the Maya jewels were going to be given to Professor Dodge. Driven to kill Dodge before he was forced to give up the jewels, he and his men listened in as District Attorney Grant Gardner learned the van was remote controlled. To track down the Scarab, Grant stowed away and let Maldor pilot the van to a garage. However, the Scarab had warned his men to expect the DA, and he was captured. The Scarab ordered his men to load the van with dynamite so he could blow up Dodge. Captain America however intervened while the van was en route, breaking the remote controls and crashing it harmlessly away from Dodge. Maldor was phoned by Professor Dodge, who revealed he planned to leave for South America, scared by the threat of the Scarab. Dodge requested the jewels, and Maldor had to agree. However, the Scarab attempted to kill Professor Dodge one final time, using an assassin. This attempt succeeded, and the expedition member was finally murdered. ===The Blackmailing of J. C. Henley=== After this effort, the Scarab began a new scheme to extort money from industrialist J. C. Henley. However, his men were followed by Captain America and he learned that the money he had been given had all been marked. The Scarab had his men attempt to blow up Henley’s plant for revenge, but Captain America intervened, limiting the damage. More driven now, the Scarab had an assassin try to kill Henley using a Singari blowgun, but the sniper was foiled by the DA. The Scarab was confident that no one could link the blowgun to him, as the only expert aware of the connection had died years ago. Maldor soon had a rude awakening as his spy learned that the expert’s grandson Grayson had followed in his grandfather’s footsteps, and he may be able to identify the blowgun’s owner. The Scarab had his men sabotage the DA’s plane, to destroy the blowgun as well as anyone aboard. The blowgun was indeed destroyed, but the Scarab soon heard rumors in the underworld that the police may have made a duplicate model of the blowgun. Not risking to chance he being uncovered, he sent all his men to investigate. Two discovered Grayson had apparently reserved a room at a hotel, and set a trap. They caught the DA, and one stayed to finish him off while the other took the blowgun. fields.trivia: It remains unclear from where in Europe Cyrus Wolfe originated. France is the most likely locale because (1) the surname "Wolfe" is commonly an Anglo-Irish surname with Norman-French origins, (2) John Wolfe mentions that Cyrus "taught himself our language" implying that he did not originate from an English speaking nation or that his native tongue was not English, and (3) Hedy Wolfe once claimed that an ancestor from a few centuries ago was a French Duke.

czar.name: Czar
czar.origin: ===Early Life=== The youth who would become Czar suffered frequent beatings from his father. His grandmother allegedly told him, "Sometimes you gotta cut the $%'#, baby... and get to the part where somebody's dyin'". At some point, he allegedly killed his own parents. Czar, alongside his diminutive partner Big Murder, became a wealthy drug dealer of some renown. ===Time Diamonds=== Temporally powered diamonds, known as Time Diamonds, grew on trees on a short-lived planet with an unstable core. When the planet exploded, these diamonds were scattered throughout the cosmos. An asteroid loaded with these diamonds struck Earth during the Cretaceous–Paleogene Extinction Event which suposedly wiped out the Dinosaurs. Some of these diamonds eventually ended up in a safety deposit box at a Manhattan bank . When the Orb and his Orblings robbed the bank containing the time diamonds, Spider-Man and Wolverine were caught in the conflict, leading them to be transported back to 66 million B.C. ===Working for Mojo=== Mojo later employed Czar and Big Murder, using their time-traveling abilities to create entertainment across the timeline. They used their newfound powers to steal historical treasures and creating a Harem of women from across the timeline, Czar and Big Murder traveled through time, encountering figures such as Genghis Khan and Joan of Arc. They manipulated events for entertainment, capturing various historical figures and even taunting Kang the Conqueror. They also battled the Knights Templar in 1150 A.D. during the Crusades, using the Timestick to banish one knight to Atomic Bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki. At one point, Czar encountered his past and future selves at his asteroid estate. His elder incarnation warned him of future mistakes, but the younger Czar dismissed these concerns. This led to a brutal confrontation in which the youngest Czar shot his oldest counterpart in the head. During a confrontation with Spider-Man and Wolverine, Czar used his Timestick, a baseball bat embedded with time diamonds, to manipulate their positions across history. However, Spider-Man stole a time diamond from him, disrupting Czar’s control. Eventually, during a battle with the two heroes, Wolverine severed Czar’s right hand, rendering him unable to wield the Time Bat effectively During this battle, Czar's Time Bat was progressively destroyed, leading Wolverine to briefly lose control while accessing the Phoenix Force. Czar ultimately found himself incapacitated as the Time Variance Authority intervened, pulling him through a temporal portal along with Big Murder and the Orb. ===Defeat=== Following his capture, Czar was last seen sitting beside an infant Big Murder, contemplating his downfall. Despite his capture, an Orbling later approached Czar with additional time diamonds, implying that his time-traveling escapades might not be over.

czorn yson.first_appearance: Death's Head II & the Origin of Die Cut Vol 1 1
czorn yson.origin: Yson belongs to a race known as the Ganalonians, who for centuries fought against a race of cyborgs, driving them to hatred of all things mechanical. While Yson was a mutant of his race, that did not stop him from joining the army and killing countless mechanical beings. He eventually captured by the cyborgs and placed him under examination to see if they could perhaps further elevate themselves by using organics. Knowing that his race's secrets were in danger, he faked being insane, allowing enough time for him to study the mechanical beings. However, this yielded no result, and eventually Yson was driven mad, losing all hope in the process. So, when Death's Head II showed up to assimilate him, he was more than happy to be free of his constant torture. Years later within a mission to cure the plague Perfection that was turning people into steel, Death's Head II was hit with purging program that was making his personalities resurface. Knowing the danger of it but also knowing the enemies would soon overwhelm them he allowed Yson to take over as he was the only one who fought them before. While Yson did fight them, he later ran into a room in a museum with cyborg parts which allowed him to re-create his body therefore gaining new chance at life. As expect from man driven mad, he was now after blood and worst of all, his mechanical-phobia had only increased by his stay inside Death's Head II.
abilities: Capable of through space in order to teleport.
weapons: A large blade equipped to his left arm.

cesar bajete.name: César Bajete
cesar bajete.origin: César Bajete was a physician specialized in pathology and a mad master torturer in the small Latin American country Bosqueverde. When General Emmanuel Raposa led a socialist uprising against democratically elected President Ricardo Dominguez (the Raposistas), Bajete sided with Raposa and met one of Raposa's hired mercenaries, Marc Spector. Spector earned Bajete's respect for his high abilities, but Spector came to despise Bajete for his brutal methods and his insanity, although Spector believed that Raposa would be a better democratic leader than Dominguez. Following Dominguez's death, Raposa easily took power and established a ferocious dictatorship in Bosqueverde, repeatedly violating human rights and spilling so much blood that his regime was considered the bloodiest in Latin America. Raposa appointed Bakete as his right-hand man and the general of his Secret Police, putting him in command of his death squads, later infamous. Spector eventually said that Raposa simply had used Bajete until Bajete was no longer useful to him, as Raposa had done with the mercenaries, but Bajete, being deranged, enjoyed even that attention. Bajete was personally responsible for several murders. thumb|left|César Bajete. Dominguez's supporters refused to recognize Raposa's legitimacy, and arranged guerrilla attacks against the new President's interests. This led to ten years of civil war, after which the resistance defeated Raposa's forces, but Raposa managed to escape the country before being captured. Some of his allies, including Bajete, were arrested. However, many Raposa supporters remained at large, awaiting their leader's return. The new democratic government led by Presidente Hector Silva immediately devoted efforts to prosecute and punish the Raposistas for war crimes and human rights violations, but they were unable to find and arrest Raposa. Correctly assuming that the Raposistas would be given the death penalty, Bajete and several Secret Police friends of his prepared a prison escape bribing a guard and resorting to some sympathizers outside; his plan was to go to the Presidential Palace immediately after leaving the prison to assassinate President Silva in vengeance and to cause a political change that could bring Raposa back to Bosqueverde. When Bosqueverde captured Spector, Raposa initially was reluctant to believe them; but once Spector was put in the same cell the Raposistas were, Bajete offered him to join the escape. Not wanting Bajete in charge again, Spector initially refused; Bajete's allies threatened Spector should he speak about this, but Spector overpowered them and had Bajete tell his goons to stay away from him. Bajete, the Raposistas and Spector were publicly tried at the Estadio E. Jacovone, chained together, under a scorching sun and protected by Army. Once they were found guilty and sentenced to hanging, Bajete staged his escape, and Spector joined in the last moment. The escape was successful, and Bajete had one of his goons murder the guard instead of paying him as promised; Spector confronted the Raposistas, especially when they insisted on murdering Silva, and Bajete had him batteredand leave him to die by throwing him through a cliff - however, Spector was rescued by his allies, his friend Frenchie and his girlfriend Marlene Alraune. Chased by the Army as a fugitive, Spector insisted in going to the Palace and save Silva - the man who had sentenced him to death. Bajete led the assault on the Palace. It started when a commercial van from "Peppino Fruta-Y-Verdura", loaded with explosives, rammed the Palace's outer wall; this was mostly a distraction to attract the defending soldiers, known to be unexperienced, while the Raposistas, identified by the green scarves around their necks, stormed the building itself with rifles. Bajete and several of his men reached the President's office, and Bajete personally put a gun on Silva's head but Spector, in his secret identity as the Moon Knight, sneaked in the Palace and helped in the defense, reaching the President's office in time. Surprised at Spector's appearance, Bajete took him for a fantasma at first, but refused to release the President. Spector easily defeated the other Raposistas there, then threatened Bajete. From a building across the street, Frenchie sharpshot Bajete, wounding his right shoulder, then Spector knocked him down, and made a deal with Silva to be pardoned himself in exchange for his promise to bring Raposa to Bosqueverde. The following day, Bajete and his allies were executed by hanging at the Estadio, but Silva pardoned Spector.
weapons: Bajete used a handgun in his attempted murder of President Silva.

fields.unusual_features: Vertical scar with stitches from the forehead to the cheek, going through the eye

d 3x.name: D-3X
d 3x.origin: D-3X worked as a Gatherer for the Collector. After the escape of two specimens, Rocket Raccoon and Howard the Duck, their two female clones that had been created for reproductive purposes, Shocket and Linda, were put under D-3X's custody until the escapees were retrieved. Over the course of six months, D-3X grew fond of the children, and he was even perceived as a father figure by them. Because Shocket's and Linda's potential mates hadn't been recovered, the two clones were to be put in cryogenic stasis. D-3X rebelled against the Collector's mandate and escaped along with the kids. Three months later, D-3X, Shocket, and Linda arrived to the planet Souqlon and, with the help of a rebel Space Phantom known as Multo, they escaped to the furthest they could go into the past, twenty-five years. Twenty years after their arrival to the past, the three fugitives became smugglers. While they were conducting business, one of their clients recognized D-3X as the person who had kidnapped their parents, unaware that it had actually been his past/present self, and blasted him with a gun. Shocket, Linda, and D-3X escaped from their attackers, but D-3X's wounds were fatal, and he died subsequently in Shocket's arms.

d avery.name: D. Avery
d avery.origin: Dr. D. Avery was a doctor who had her medical practice in the village/reservation of Dunroman. Hawkeye brought the injured Rover to her office and she sought the help of the local veterinarian not knowing whether to treat him like a human or an animal. After healing Rover, and learning that he was a secretly artificially mutated creature in a remote Secret Empire facility, she asked Hawkeye if he should call on his Avengers colleagues for help, but Hawkeye refused to do so, saying that he would resolve the issue together with Rover. This ended up being a grave mistake, as the Secret Empire razed the village to the ground, killing all its inhabitants, including Dr. Avery.

d k.name: D.K.
d k.species: Human mutated by a toxic chemical explosion.
d k.origin: David Kalen and his brother Henry were originally environmental consultants who were exposed to toxic sludge while investigating the actions of corrupt businessman Mr. Sanders near Greenlawn in Huntington, New York. Although Henry was killed in the accident, David was somehow mutated into the monstrous DK, capable of decaying matter merely by touching it. He was talked out of killing Sanders by Spider-Man, who convinced him to go to the Ravencroft Institute for help. As time went on; however, David became increasingly dangerous due to his survivor's guilt over his brother's death, to the extent that his power began to turn inwards, whether consciously or subconsciously was never clarified, and he began to destroy himself. Despite the efforts of Peter Parker, now Spider-Man once again after Ben's death, Kalen eventually destroyed himself, breaking out of Ravencroft to thank Spider-Man one last time for believing in him. Even after death; however, he left a legacy behind him; when the currently-rejuvenated Vulture attacked Spider-Man as part of his attempt to kill everyone who knew him as an old man, the sludge that had been Kalen reached up to attack the Vulture, apparently undoing the rejuvenation process and leaving the Vulture an old man once more. D.K. later attacked Greenlawn on Long Island, but was confronted by the X-Men. They called in the aid of Maggott because his slugs Eany and Meenie could eat anything. However, DK wasn't completely taken down and used his giant hand to kill Maggott.
powers: As DK, David Kalen possessed and the ability to dissolve matter with a touch.

daak.name: Daak
daak.origin: Daak was the warden of a classified Shi'ar galactic gulag located in deep space far away from any sentient life. This prison was constructed and reserved to hold the most dangerous prisoners in the universe. Warden Daak's job also consisted of mentally breaking his prisoners to ensure they wouldn't pose a threat if they ever escaped. Following his arrest at the hands of the Imperial Guard, Thanos was imprisoned at the gulag overseen by Daak. The Mad Titan had been struck with a fatal illness, and remained agonizing in his cell. Daak decided to mock Thanos for his predicament, and disabled the force field surrounding the fallen Mad Titan in the process. As it turned out, while still fatally sick, Thanos had been faking the severity of his affliction. The Mad Titan caught Daak off-guard and tore of his arm in order to use his hand to open the cell's door. Daak was left behind agonizing.

As Daarroh figured that Aaron was "one who let the spider in" (a Spider-Totem), he left him with a warning that all mankind was doomed before leaving his host.

daboia.name: Daboia
daboia.origin: A demonic serpent man, Daboia was employed by Nicholas Scratch to spread demonic influence throughout America. Posing as a well-respected resort manager, he convinced Hedy Wolfe to hire him to oversee a project to transform the town of Centerville into a Patsy Walker-themed resort and amusement park. At the same time, he allied himself with the Sons of the Serpent organisation, deceiving them into believing that he supported their racist ideology. With their help, he was able to summon an army of demons who possessed most of the people of Centerville. When Patsy Walker herself came to visit Centerville, she became aware of the demonic presence in the town and called in the Avengers to investigate. When the Avengers infiltrated his secret base, Daboia realized he had been exposed and transformed back into his true form of a Serpent Man. While the Avengers were distracted fighting the Sons of the Serpent, Daboia summoned Salem's Seven to join the fight, before retreating into his sanctum. There, he began a ritual to summon forth an army of ghostly demon serpents to destroy the Avengers. He was interrupted by Hedy Wolfe, who disrupted his magical spells by tipping over a magical brazier, causing its contents to burn away the pentagram that was integral to his ritual spells. Daboia and the Salem's Seven vanished in a cloud of sulfur, and the demons he had unleashed upon Centerville were similarly banished. Some time later, Daboia was sighted in Hell, attending a meeting of the Devil's Advocacy to discuss the return of the Serpent. Daboia climbed all the way up from the Pit, and was one of the many magical rivals who sought to kill the Scarlet Witch after she absorbed the Darkhold and sealed Chthon inside her soul. Daboia tried to attack her during her sleep but tripped one of her dimensional snare traps. He was stranded in a pocket reality in a jar kept at the Emporium shop in Lotkill, New York City, where he last left to fight a fake Scarlet Witch.

dacio.name: Dacio
dacio.species: Human whose brain was transfer to an artificial body
dacio.origin: Dacio was a mobster who was captured for his crimes by the Sub-Mariner. Due to the extent of his crimes, he was scheduled to be executed by hanging. The night before his execution, Dr. Corbin nearly completed his artificial man but required a real human brain to bring it to life. Learning of Dacio's pending execution, Corbin made arrangements to obtain the mobster's brain after his death. On the day of Dacio's execution, one of Dacio's men (named Rocky) attempted to spring his boss but was subdued by the Sub-Mariner, who was on site to watch the execution. Dacio was summarily executed, his final words to the gathered crowd being "Tell the Sub-Mariner I'll be waitin' for him in Hades!" After the execution, Dacio's body was picked up by Dr. Corbin who removed the mobster's brain and put it in the massive body of his artificial man. Charging the body, Crobin succeeded in bringing Dacio to life. However, Dacio had no intentions of being a marvel of science and broke out of Corbin's lab, seeking to reclaim his criminal operations. His first act was to spring Rocky out of jail, leading to a clash with the authorities. Freeing his friend, Dacio (now dubbed "The Horror That Walks" by the media) clashed with the Sub-Mariner again. Namor stood no chance against Dacio's superior strength on dry land. Knocking the hero out, Dacio and Rocky fled the scene when the authorities arrived. Dacio reunited with his minions and then used his superior power and horrifying looks to force all the other rival gangs out of the area, gaining a monopoly on crime in the area. However, this new power came at a price: unable to eat, the artificial flesh of Dacio's new body would serve as his only source of nourishment, causing him to waste away. Realizing that Corbin could be the source of more nourishment, he and his gang payed the doctor a visit. By this time, the Sub-Mariner had met with Corbin, and the two were waiting for Dacio to return. The monster mobster knocked out Namor and revitalized himself with more artificial flesh. He then violently forced Corbin to give him the formula to make more. Namor eventually revived and took their fight out to the nearby water. Unable to swim, Dacio refused to go anywhere the water was deep enough to completely submerge him. Taking advantage of this, Namor struck Dacio in the head with a rusty anchor, causing him to topple into the deeper waters. There, Namor drowned his enemy, killing him once and for all. Namor dragged Dacio's remains -- the giant artificial skeleton that housed his brain -- noting that the artificial flesh melted off after his death.

daddy wronglegs.name: Daddy Wronglegs
daddy wronglegs.origin: Daddy Wronglegs was an alien being who arrived on earth with several others of its kind. It set up headquarters near Manhattan Bridge and started to distribute a new drug, one which may have been produced from his own body. He was tracked down by Punisher who infiltrated his hideout and tracked down Daddy Wronglegs who revealed his true nature and attack. A short fight ensued, which was very one sided as the creature was bulletproof. Wronglegs brought in his "drones" to attack and Punisher was overwhelmed and eventually cornered in the stairwell to the roof with the door outside welded shut. The Punisher was saved by the Fantastic Four, and Wronglegs was captured and taken to the Baxter Building for further study.

daemos.name: Daemos
daemos.origin: Daemos was one of the many children of Solus, as well as he is a totem hunter, feasting on life energy of others, particularly Spider-Men, and he used his large hammer as a lethal weapon. The Inheritors were brought to Earth-TRN389 by Goblin. They made a deal where if they delivered the native Spider-Man to her, she would give them access to Earth-41940, home to the Spider-Men. When that world's Spider-Man arrived in Nueva York, it was Daemos he first encountered. Spider-Man-41940 discovered that Daemos and the Inheritors didn't recognize him. Parker figured out that the Spider-Men were from the future relative to the Inheritors, having helped defeat them during the Totem War. With this knowledge, they were able to recuse O'Hara and use the Goblin's temporal emitters to send the Inheritors back to Earth-001. When the Inheritors managed to gather three spider-totems needed to perform a ritual, The Other, The Scion, and The Bride, the Spider-Army formed to oppose the Inheritors travelled to their base, Loomworld, to stop them. In the end, the Spider-Army managed to overpower the Inheritors and stop the ritual which would've ended them all. The Inheritors were left in Earth-3145, a universe with a radioactive Earth, where they would die due to them being extremely vulnerable to radiation, and couldn't escape, because the Master Weaver they had enslaved and used to travel across the Multiverse had been killed. However, Spider-Man gave them the knowledge of a shelter in Sims Tower, where they could survive, but not pose a threat anymore. The Inheritors eventually escaped their prison after Jennix managed to hack Otto Octavius's databases, using Otto's spare clone bodies as a means of transferring their souls into Earth-616, engaging the Spider-Army once more. After the defeat of their father, the Spider-Army managed to turn all other Inheritors except Morlun in to babies and remove their hunger for Totems. They were sent to live with Spider-Ma'am on Earth-3123. After the totemic wasp-goddess Shathra had been freed once more, she eventually corrupted Spider-Ma'am and killed all baby Inheritors, Daemos included.

dafydd ap andras.origin: ===Origins=== left|thumb|Dafydd meeting his older self "Damian Tryp Sr." Dafydd ap Andras was born in a small village in the south of Wales in the 14th Century. Dafydd's mother died in childbirth, and at birth he began to manifest mutant powers; he was stronger and smarter than other kids his age. In 1347 the Black Death spread into the village. The villagers blamed it on Dafydd, believing what he was a "changeling" (a child replaced by the faeries). The villagers wanted to sacrifice Dafydd in order to stop the plague, but his father, Andras, refused to give in to their demands. The villagers then set fire to his home, killing Andras and nearly killing Dafydd. Dafydd was saved by Damian Tryp Sr., his own future version who returned into the past and teleported Dafydd from the burning house. Dafydd then travelled the world, studying dark magic, seeking to become immortal. As time passed, Dafydd's mutant powers evolved and linked him to the Earth's elemental essence. Thanks to it his aging slowed down and he was now existing simultaneously across all points of his timeline. He lived for centuries, and by the 21st century adopted the name Damian Tryp and established the Singularity Investigations. It was controlled by three versions of himself: Damian Tryp Sr. a middle aged man in his 40s who acted as the CEO of the Singularity Investigations, Damian Tryp Jr. a younger version in his 20s, who pretended to be the son of the Tryp Sr. and served as the second-in-command of the company, and Tryp the Eldest or the Old Man a version from the far future who returned to the present day and served as the advisor to his younger selves. ===Damian Tryp Sr.=== thumb|right|Speaking to Drs. Daniel and Joan Madrox Decades ago Tryp Sr. visited Dr. Daniel Madrox and Dr. Joan Madrox at their home in Kansas, offering their son Jamie a place in his organization. Tryp Sr. told them that Jaime was not truly a mutant, but rather a "killcrop" like himself, an evolutionary throwback whose X-Gene activated at birth rather than at puberty. Therefore, Tryp Sr. argued, he was more qualified to look after Jaime than Professor Charles Xavier, with whom the couple had been corresponding. The Madroxes declined the offer, so Tryp Sr. erased their and Jamie's memories about his visit. Not long after, Tryp Sr. conjured a tornado that killed the Madroxes, leaving Jamie an orphan. ===Tryp the Eldest=== thumb|right|Tryp the Eldest In the Old Man's timeline the effect of the Decimation was reversed by X-Factor Investigations. Mutants were repowered and soon became the dominant species on Earth. Humanity was almost completely exterminated, leading mutants to fight each other for the control of the world, plunging the planet into chaos. Years later Tryp became so old what he was no longer able to survive solely through his powers. His temporal stability was supported by advanced machinery and a small group of loyal followers. The Old Man always opposed the meaningless conflicts of his fellow mutants, but his advice fell on deaf ears. Eventually they tracked him down, killed all his followers and destroyed the machines that maintained his temporal stability. As a result Tryp became trapped between planes of existence. Tryp rematerialized on Earth-616 shortly after the Decimation and joined his younger selves. He decided to ensure that the world would not follow the same path as in his timeline, and thus planned to either stop X-Factor Investigations or eradicate the few surviving mutants with the Legacy Virus. ===Versus X-Factor Investigations=== One of the first encounters between X-Factor and Singularity Investigations occurred when Tryp Jr. badly beat Siryn after shooting her in the neck with a dart that prevented her from using her powers and left her for dead. At the time, Siryn was investigating the murder of Rachel Santiago, who died in the pent house of movie star Jack Vaughn under suspicious circumstances. Jack Vaughn, client of SI, attempted to frame Rachel's sister, Gloria Santiago. Gloria hired X-Factor Investigations to help her clear her name and bring Jack to justice. X-Factor Investigations successfully managed to incriminate Vaughn, and to thwarted SI's assassination attempt on Rictor. Enraged about the loss, Tryp Jr. then ambushed Siryn. To send a message, Madrox and Strong Guy gave Tryp Jr. a very public warning in Central Park during Tryp's morning jog. After this threat, Tryps Sr. and Jr. arranged a meeting with Madrox offering to buy out X-Factor and recruit his team. Madrox laughed in their faces, and was nearly killed by being pushed out a window. Thankfully, Madrox Prime had sent a dupe to the meeting in his place. X-Factor's next encounter with Tryp and SI occurred when Henry Buchanan, a former Singularity employee, came to the X-Factor and revealed Tryp's plans to create and modify a new version of the Legacy Virus specifically designed to target former mutants. dagan shah.name: Dagan Shah
dagan shah.origin: A rebel leader, he was captured by Qatari soldiers, but quickly escaped after releasing a grenade he'd held in his mouth. Stumbling through the desert, he collapsed, only to be engulfed in a white light. Discovering lost Rigellian technology, he used his powers to transform three scientists into his servants, then began creating and selling extremely powerful weapons to local terrorist groups. Created in such a way that made reverse engineering lethal to those who tried, Shah created a lucrative arms business for himself, taking in money and food, which he used to fund a separation of an area along the border of Libya and Egypt he then dubbed "Sharzhad". When Red Hulk and Machine Man came to investigate Sharzhad, Shah met them as Arabian Knight, letting them into the force field-protected Sharzhad and accompanying them to the palace. Once there, he revealed himself as Shah and imprisoned the two while revealing that he had also captured the real Arabian Knight. Using his enhanced powers, he probed Red Hulk's mind to find that outside forces had a hand in sending Red Hulk to him. Flying to Cairo, he threatened the populace, saying nothing would stop him from creating and controlling Sharzhad. Returning, he attacked the recently escaped Machine Man and Red Hulk, ripping Machine Man in two. Employing a range of abilities against the duo, Shah fought them until Arabian Knight broke free and cut off Dagan Shah's arms (yet Dagan managed to reattach his arms). Shah still found himself on the ropes until the arrival of General Reggie Fortean, who informed Red Hulk that Shah's Sharzhad had been officially recognized as a nation by the Arab League, and that Red Hulk was trespassing on foreign soil. With Dagan Shah informing Red Hulk that he had two minutes to leave, Red Hulk reluctantly released him and left the new nation, with Shah vowing to eventually get his revenge on Red Hulk.

daggaerdh.name: Daggaerdh
daggaerdh.origin: In Harrowpoint Island, Washington, Valkyrie, Misty, Annabelle and Hippolyta arrived, having "racked the resonance of the ancient rituals to"the town, which they found abandoned and filled with mannequins dressed as superheroes. Valkyrie soon experienced a sensation that drew her to a church, and the group descended into the basement to find a subterranean cavern where the Doommaidens – Arnleif (maiden of seduction), Aldvi (maiden of deceit), Balda (maiden of slaughter), Hermotha (maiden of filth), Daggaerdh (maiden of torture), Siggota (maiden of vermin), Disthora (maiden of insanity), and Nedra (maiden of carrion) – had been successfully awoken. Hippolyta immediately attacked Daggaerdh and Hermotha, and Valkyrie battled Balda as Mr. Raven and Caroline Le Fay watched. Misty laid down coverfire as Annabelle pried open the stone throne and released Dani, even though "the ritual was mostly complete," and Valkyrie was attacked by Nedra as Hippolyta was subdued by Arnleif. Valkyrie suddenly experienced an "awakening," however, and the Doommaidens bowed to her as she transformed her into the maiden of rage.

dagger mobster.name: Dagger (Mobster)
dagger mobster.origin: The mobster known as the Dagger was active during the 1940s. By 1944 he was operating a lucrative operation selling black market produce during a period of war rationing. He operated from a camouflaged warehouse located outside of Happy Corner, New York. He would send his men to local farms and threaten the local farmers to sell his produce at his prices or risk having their crops and livestock killed with pesticides. The Dagger's activities attracted the attention of the Human Torch and Toro who began working at one of the local farms as field workers as a cover for their investigation. When one of the local farmers was gunned down in cold blood, the Torch and Toro chased after the mobsters as they got away, forcing the car to crash. Finding a survivor in the wreckage, the Torch and Toro learned the location of the Dagger's hideout. When the two flaming heroes arrived, they incapacitated the Dagger's shipping trucks and chased the elderly crook into his warehouse. There the Dagger filled the warehouse with his pesticide which not only snuffed out the two heroes flames but also threatened to kill them if they did not get out into the fresh air. The Dagger then attempted to escape with all his ill gotten fortune, but his car was incapacitated by the Torch and Toro and he was taken into police custody. His subsequent fate is unknown.
weapons: The Dagger used a pesticide that could kill plants and livestock. It also was able to snuff out the flame powers of the Human Torch and Toro.

daglio.name: Daglio
daglio.origin: Daglio was a sailor on the ship hired by Lance Johnson and his daughter, Cecilia to find a sunken treasure ship off the coast of California. Daglio, however, led the crew into a mutiny, killing the ship's captain in the process, in order to gain the treasure for themselves. The Sub-Mariner witnessed this and attempted to thwart the mutiny, but Daglio grazed his head with a bullet, knocking him out. The crew did not realize who Namor was, so they simply tied him up and threw him overboard, assuming that the would drown. Daglio then turned his attentions to the Johnsons, threatening Lance to reveal the sunken ship's location, but it wasn't until he threatened his daughter that Johnson agreed to show them. The crew sent a diver down to investigate the sunken ship, but he was attacked by Namor who then dressed up in his diver's equipment in order to sneak aboard the vessel. Once aboard, he quickly beat the crew into submission and began to return the ship to port. Daglio, however, was not about to admit defeat and had the ship's cook start a fire on the boat. While Namor rushed to extinguish the blaze, Daglio and the crew took the treasure and escaped aboard the ship's lifeboats. Namor quickly put out the fire and sunk the lifeboat, forcing the crew back to the ship with the treasure. Presumably, Daglio and the other crew members were arrested upon making it back to port. His subsequent activities have been unrevealed.

dagny forrester.name: Dagny Forrester
dagny forrester.origin: Dagny Forrester was born to wealth. She and her brother Cedric became scientists and formed a research company with laboratories in New York and the South of France. Together, Dagny and Cedric develop the Corona experiment that consists of putting a human subject in a big tube filled with a yellow liquid and subjecting them to chemical and radiation treatments which in turn endows them with super-powers. Dagny volunteers to undergo the process but Cedric chickens out halfway through, which turns Dagny into Corona but leaves her with less than the full power she craves. During the experiment, chemicals are flushed into the New York water system. As a result, New Yorkers (including Peter Parker's wife Mary Jane Watson) start contracting a disease that becomes known as SoHo fever. Attempting to help the sick, Spider-Man finds himself caught in the middle of the feud between Cedric and Corona. Cedric has an antidote for the fever but first wants to make sure Corona is captured so he can experiment on her. Corona wants the antidote to gain her full power, which will also prevent her from exploding like an atomic bomb. In the stalemate that follows, Corona accidentally wipes out the antidote. She doesn't explode but instead metamorphoses into a hag-like "shriveled husk". She blames this change on Spider-Man. Eventually, Cedric and Harry Osborn recreate the antidote. Spidey saves Corona from committing suicide only to have her knocked unconscious by Cedric's armed guards. Spidey wants to help her but he is blocked by a court order that gives Cedric custody of his sister. Cedric gets away scot-free. He hauls Corona off to use as a laboratory guinea pig. Once in the lab, Cedric implants a bio-monitor that stabilizes Corona's body chemistry so that she loses the "shriveled husk" look. But the monitor also stimulates the pain centers of the brain when triggered by a remote. This turns Corona into Cedric's slave. Later, though, a cheap hood named Lenny "The Operator" Flynn takes the remote away. Lenny takes over Cedric's business and uses Corona as his bodyguard. Eventually Spider-Man intercedes, the remote is destroyed, Lenny turns tail and runs, Spidey dumps Cedric into a garbage can, and a freed Corona flies away to seek her destiny. That destiny has yet to be revealed.

dai kumo.name: Dai Kumo
dai kumo.origin: Dai Kumo was a Yakuza crime lord from Osaka, Japan. The oyabun wore the symbol of his clan where all could see, tattooed on his forehead. He devised a plan for distribution of a new drug called "Zap" or "Thunderbolt", using the brains of an endangered species of monkey from the island of Madripoor. After buying off the local prince and crime lords, Dai Kumo believed his only remaining threat was a local bar owner named Patch. Twenty Yakuza soldiers failed to kill Patch at the Princess Bar, prompting Dai Kumo's personal assassin Goro to oversee the final strike. Goro drove a sword through Patch's chest, and took a polaroid of the "dead man" as proof for his boss. Patch wasn't dead. Secretly the mutant hero Wolverine, Patch made his way to Japan and survived being buried alive before confronting Dai Kumo and his backers. In the end, Dai Kumo was killed by one of his underlings, the girl named Reiko, in order to secure her freedom from the Yakuza.

daija hamilton.name: Daija Hamilton
daija hamilton.origin: Daija Hamilton was a high school student who came across freshman Riri Williams when she couldn't open the lock on her locker. While trying to come up with some scientific reason, Daija noticed that gum was stuck in the enclosure of the lock and got security to help Riri with it. After some time passed, Daija was seen at Riri's graduation were she met Riri's mother Ronnie Williams and after a talk about how she was a classmate of Riri's and how she didn't graduate due to family circumstances. Mrs. Williams invited Daija over to their house for some caramel cake. Years later, Riri's personal assistant N.A.T.A.L.I.E. pulled up an article about Daija claiming that she was a missing woman. Riri started an investigation on Dajai's disappearance but when she got done with a battle with armed robbers she noticed a missing persons flyer with Daija's face on it. Daija was being held in a warehouse unconscious while a mysterious person used her as an example to some other children on what would happen to them if they failed. left|thumb|Daija unconscious As Riri's investigation towards Daija came up as a dead end, a newscast reported that Daija has been located and while doing an interview with her, Daija divulged that she ran away from home due to stress and anxiety and tripped over a tree branch in a wooded area outside the city which knocked her unconscious. Later that night, Dajai was visited by Riri at her bedroom window, but as Riri tried to talk to her, Daija rebuked anything that Riri said and asked her to leave which she did. As the mysterious person was in Daija's closet she told him that Riri was not coming back but he told her that if he left her alone that Riri's interest in her would wane but that was not the case. Daija screamed about the threat on Riri's life it caused her mother to come into the room and try to calm Daija down. The next day Daija took a bus to an abandoned building as Riri followed her in her armor while in stealth mode. Ironheart walked in as Daija held a gun to the head of city council member Thomas Birch who Daija blamed for using her and all the missing children to commit crimes in order for him to be elected governor of Illinois. Birch admitted that this ploy was put in place by more powerful people and that Daija was nothing more than a pawn. Ironheart told her that even if Birch was repulsive and terrible, he was not worth throwing her life away for. While Daija was distracted, Birch grabbed her and the gun using Daija as leverage against Ironheart. Birch commented that Riri was nothing special but just a normal human. This prompted Ironheart to shoot him with a high-viscosity adhesive liquid that turned him into a giant electromagnet. During this point, Midnight's Fire jumped out of the shadows to battle Ironheart but Riri was able to open up a portal for Daija and the kids to pass through. After the battle was over, Daija called her mother to let her know that she was okay and told her where she was at. Riri's friend Xavier King came by and picked up Daija and some of the kids as they said their goodbyes to Ironheart.

daimyo.name: Daimyo
daimyo.origin: The man known as Daimyo was a Japan warlord; in his quest for power, he conquered several territories, causing death and destruction. He destroyed a village at Mount Hiei despite a fierce warrior opposed him; the warrior then retired on a mountain and became a Monk. He stole the territories of an English nobleman, Mr. Braddock who then committed suicide, leaving his wife and daugther alone against the world. Daimyo even plundered the village where the wife of samurai Akagi lived; she killed herself not to be kidnapped by the warlord's army and when Akagi returned from the Korean War he swore revenge. Daimyo was also responsible for killing the master of some of the deadliest samurais ever and then convinced one of them to trick the others to kill them. In addition to that, during a war, Daimyo sent his best warrior to die, as he retained him too dangerous. Daimyo became a tyrant over his reign, he rose the taxes after the Korean War and some said that he had fun in hunting people, but some others viewed him as benevolent as crimes decreased since he took the power. Meanwhile, several of Daimyo's enemies decided to hunt him down at the same time; they were: Akagi, Mr. Braddock's daugther (the Butterfly), the Ronin who Cannot Die and a mysterious scarred wayfarer. After meeting the wayfarer while riding his horse, he then met the Butterfly as he intended to take her with him for the night, but when he saw her wound in her hand he decided to sleep alone. Suddenly, during the night he remembered where he had previously seen the wayfarer and called his guards, just to realize everybody else in his palace had been killed; he then heard whistling and following that sound he reached the intruder: he was his former best warrior who had survived but went completely mad, he only remembered that he wanted to kill Daimyo, but not why. The two fought in Daimyo's garden until the samurai killed his former master, even if he didn't totally realized what he had done.
abilities: Skilled swordsman.
weapons: A sword.

daisuke inhuman.name: Daisuke (Inhuman)
daisuke inhuman.species: Human with latent Inhuman lineage activated by the Terrigen BombCategory:Human/Inhuman HybridsCategory:Hybrids
daisuke inhuman.origin: Daisuke was a citizen of Matsumoto, Japan when the Terrigen Cloud swept through the city. Daisuke was one of people who was exposed to the cloud and underwent Terrigenesis. During his time in the cocoon, Hydra attacked the town hoping to get their hands on him and the other cocoons while they were still dormant in order to get them back to the lab for testing. However they were confronted by Crystal and the rest of the Royal Inhuman Diplomatic Mission. As the fight ensued, Daisuke emerged from stasis with some new physical changes, he then suddenly released some form of blue energy from his eyes and body that engulfed the members of Hydra putting them in a sleep induced trance. Crystal extended an invitation to Daisuke to come join them. His first mission with the Inhuman Mission was to aid the X-Men in evacuating the mutant population in Madrid, Spain go they weren't harmed by an approaching Terrigen Cloud as it was discovered that the Terrigen Mists were harmful to mutants. However, a psychic message sent by Cyclops warning Earth of the potential harm the Mists could inflict caused a riot to break out in Madrid. Seeing things getting out of control, Crystal ordered Daisuke to end the riot with his powers. Daisuke managed to put the entire city to sleep, but he also put to the X-Men to sleep, then, pressed by his fellow Inhumans, choose the Inhuman name/code-name Downer. When the X-Men woke up, they confronted the Inhumans over what Daisuke did to them. To stop a fight from breaking out, Daisuke prepared to put the X-Men to sleep again over the objections of Crystal when Magik appeared and kidnapped him before disappearing.

daisy schilling.name: Daisy Schilling
daisy schilling.origin: Texas model Daisy Schilling was Armadillo's girlfriend, whom he met during his short tenure as a superhero in the Rangers. After being kicked off the team, Armadillo became self-deprecating and distant, leading Daisy to abandon him under the impression that he didn't love her anymore. Some time later, Daisy became engaged to rodeo star Wyatt Taft. The rodeo in Houston where they announced their engagement was attacked by a drunken Armadillo, who made a scene trying to prove his worth to Daisy. Antonio was confronted by Houston's own vigilante, the Scarlet Spider, but it was Daisy who stopped her ex-boyfriend's rampage when she ran up to him and admitted that she still had feelings for him. They ultimately got back together after clearing up the misunderstanding that led to their break-up. However, Antonio and Daisy's rocky relationship caused him to run away and get into minor fights with superheroes. Worried about Antonio, Daisy hired private investigator Jessica Jones to find him. Jones located Armadillo and convinced him to return home. The couple was once more reunited, and Armadillo even agreed to go to couples therapy with Daisy.

daka.name: Daka
daka.origin: Daka is the uncle of Namor the Sub-Mariner. During one of Namor's lengthier absences from Atlantis in 1941, Daka took over the kingdom turning most of the population against him. Those who remained loyal to Namor (such as his mother Fen and cousin Lady Dorma) were locked away in prison. Daka formed an alliance with the Seal People and the Nazis. They mobilized an invasion force to attack Argentina, the first phase in their plan to invade South America and then North America. When Namor eventually returned to Atlantis, he was arrested and locked up, but later freed by Lady Dorma. Freeing the other captives, Namor learned of Daka's plans and lead a counter attack with an army of loyalists. During the fight, Namor confronted Daka and Lonu-Ne (Emperor of the Seal People) and turned them over to the Argentinian military they were attacking. Daka's fate following his capture is unknown.

dakini.name: Dakini
dakini.origin: Dakini was a tracker and assassin working for Baron Strucker's Hydra. When three genetic experiments escaped Hydra custody, Dakini was sent to hunt down Cassandra Romulus. She refused to work with her fellow hunter Ron Takimoto, preferring to act alone in pursuit of her prey. Dakini was a fanatic and decided the genetic freaks from the experiments were a blight on Hydra's name. As a result, she chose to ignore Strucker's orders to take Romulus alive. Dakini got into a three-way battle with Captain America and Romulus, where she suffered serious injuries and was captured, with her survival uncertain.

Having Kull survived, he murdered the priest not to raise any suspicion on his loyalty.

dale sturm.name: Dale Sturm
dale sturm.origin: Dale Sturm studied in the FBI Academy in Quantico, Virginia. After graduating, he soon became one of the agency's top operatives. In 1940, he was assigned to hunt down and capture Red Corker, a notorious killer and criminal overlord who managed to escape from prison. Tracking the criminal to San Francisco, Dale was taken at gunpoint and was to be brought Red Corker to be eliminated. He was able to force the car off the road, however, and reports claimed him dead. Dale used this ruse to trick Corker into slipping up when Corker kidnapped the daughter of oil magnate George Dean. Scouting the San Francisco area in a plane, Dale located Corker and his men in the abandoned Dream Island area. He shot Red down, and his men were soon apprehended. His mission a success, Dale was congratulated by J. Edgar Hoover himself. Afterwards, Dale continued his FBI duties. His subsequent activities, however, are unrevealed.

abilities: Dale is well versed in criminal and civil law and enforcement operations, specializing in subversion and . He is an expert pilot and marksman, and an excellent hand-to-hand combatant.
weapons: Dale carries an FBI issue pistol and is specialized in the .38 Harrington & Richardson caliber pistol.

dalili.name: Dalili
dalili.species: Human resurrected as a walking dead
dalili.origin: Dalili was a woman from Zothique. At some point, she sailed from Oroth, and ended up on the Isle of Na'at along with the crew of the vessel. She sired two sons with her husband, the necromancer Vacharn. Wokal and Uldulla both became necromancers as well. She was killed by Vacharn who resurrected her to preserve her youthful beauty and faithfulness for his lusts. ; It is unclear whether she gave birth to Vacharn's sons before or after her death. Like others of the undead servitors of Vacharn, Dalili was sent diving in the unleashed sea to harvest pearls, the source of the necromancers' wealth. When Conan's ship crashed on the shores of Na'at, Dalili was sent by Vacharn and his sons to rescue the Cimmerian from drowning, for him to serve as a blood sacrifice for his demon-familiar Esrit. Conan later learned from Wokal and Uldulla that Dalili was their mother, a walking dead dedicated to serve Vacharn's lusts forever. After the necromancers and demons were all killed, Conan gathered the undead servants, including Dalili, and had them build a pyre to destroy the necromancers' bodies. Before he ordered Dalili to enter the fire, Conan witnessed a tear in her eyes, as her husband's and sons' bodies were burned.

dallas gibson.name: Dallas Gibson
dallas gibson.origin: ===Origin=== When his powers first manifested, Dallas accidentally scared his grandfather causing him to have a heart attack. Afterward, Dallas was enrolled at the Xavier Institute. ===Xavier Institute=== Originally Emma Frost was assigned as Dallas' mentor. Like the other Hellions, Emma allowed Dallas to choose his codename, Specter. When the Xavier Institute began the training squad system, Dallas was placed in the Paragons Squad with Wolfsbane as his advisor. Later for unclear reasons, Specter and DJ switched squads, and Specter became a part of the Corsairs under Cyclops. ===M-Day=== Specter was one of the many mutants to lose their powers on M-Day. The depowered students of the Xavier Institute were asked to leave the school, but the bus carrying several depowered students was attacked by one of William Stryker's Purifiers. Dallas, however, departed from the Institute early, and went to live with his grandparents. ===Krakoa=== Specter later became a citizen of Krakoa and has regained his mutant powers by participating in the Crucible. At some point Dallas started dating Graymalkin and together they enrolled into Bishop's War College program. They were placed into the group with D-Cel, Gimmick and Kafka and together participated in a mission to apprehend Snot and Infestation. Their group later attended the Hellfire Gala and congratulated D-Cel with the victory of her friend Juggernaut in the vote for becoming a member of the X-Men.

dalt kendall.name: Dalt Kendall
dalt kendall.origin: The man known as the Shocker was a scientist who was obsessed with electric eels. From a secret lab hidden in an abandoned sewer tunnel he bred a pair of massive electric eels. By his own accounts, he began exposing himself to their shocks and eventually his body adapted an immunity to them and he gained the ability to produce electricity on his own. With his new power, the Shocker then began robbing banks, using his electricity to kill anyone who stood in his way. His first robbery was observed by Madeline Joyce who pursued him in her costumed identity of Miss America, but the Shocker managed to escape by diving into New York Harbor and escaping through his secret tunnel. During a second robbery, the Shocker once more eluded Miss America by diving into the harbor. When she attempted to follow after him under water, he unleashed his electrical powers forcing her to retreat out of the water. Eventually, Miss America learned about the abandoned tunnel and followed it to the Shocker's secret lab. There, the Shocker revealed how he gained his powers and then attacked, hoping to kill the heroine. Flying out of range in the rooms high ceiling, Miss America pretended to knock herself out by flying into the ceiling of the room. When the Shocker approached her, she attacked and began hitting him before he had a chance to shock her. The blows sent the Shocker reeling into his massive fish tank containing two giant eels and he was devoured by his creations. Later the authorities gassed the tunnels to kill the eels.
abilities: The Shocker was a brilliant scientist.
weapons: The Shocker biologically engineered two massive electric eels which carried lethal electrical charges.

dalton wells.name: Dalton Wells
dalton wells.origin: Dalton Wells was the banker in Placer City, California. Seeking to get his mortgagors ranches, he hired a gang of outlaws to rob the ranchers and set their homes ablaze. This plot was eventually discovered by the Texas Kid who happened to be at the location of the arsonists latest attack but was unable to save the life of rancher Benito Thompson. Learning that all the properties attacked where paid for by mortgages loaned out by Wells, the Texas Kid stole the loot taken by the raiders and attempted to trick Wells into implicating himself by asking C.E.Humboldt, one of the other mortgagor targeted by gang of Wells, to toss a false note into Placer City bank with half of the stolen loot. Sure enough, Wells went to check on his men to see what they were up to. The Texas Kid clashed with them, keeping them busy long enough for the sheriff to come and arrest them all.

dam ayido wede.name: Dam-Ayido Wede
dam ayido wede.origin: ===Origin=== Dam-Ayido Wede or Dan-Ayido-Hwedo was the son of Lusa and Mahu, and twin brother to Sagbata. He was born in Orun, the Great Beyond. He started as a relatively minor member of the Vodū pantheon. He was either mistaken for the Set-Spawn known as Damballah, or impersonated him, deliberately usurped his identity and worshippers. ===16th century=== In the 16th century, at the start of the Atlantic slave trade, Dam-Ayido followed his enslaved worshippers to the Caribbean and to the USA's Gulf Coast. The slaves sought solace from their ancient gods, combining them with elements from Catholicism and the Holy Roman Church. Vodū worship was consequently bastardized into: "Vaudou" and later "voodoo" (due to confusion with the French "vaudois", a French heresy) in Saint-Domingue (modern-day Haiti). In Cuba, this merger combined to indigenous American beliefs became known as Santeria. Dam-Ayido changed his image to comport with Western culture. He adopted the name Damballah and posed as the Vodū Sky Father and creator of the world to his worshipers, usurping his grandfather Buluku and achieving far greater prominence in the New World. Consequently, Damballah was invoked by many Haitian voodoo practitioners, over Lusa, Mahu or Buluku.

dame kackle.name: Dame Kackle
dame kackle.origin: Dame Kackle was a Nazi operative who would smuggle individuals into the United States. While attempting to smuggle Japanese spies into New York in 1941, one of her men tossed a dead spy overboard. This would be spotted by US Marine Don Stevens (Secretly the Defender) and his boy sidekick Rusty. When they boarded Kackle's ship to demand answers Kackle and her crew denied seeing any Japanese in the past few months. Stevens and Rusty would change into their costumed identities and confront Kackle and her minions, discovering the truth. In the course of the battle, Kackle jumped overboard, leaving her men to be captured. She disappeared below the waves. Given her experience at sea, it seems unlikely she drowned. Her current activities are unknown.
abilities: Kackle was an expert ship captain and human smuggler. She was a capable fighter.
weapons: Kackle used a cat-of-nine-tails as her primary weapon.

damek.origin: Damek is in some way related to the villain Dreamkiller, a sometime foe of Darkhawk. In the 2099 Universe, Damek was given the misconception that Dreamkiller was a hero in his time, and Darkhawk (or, as he is known in the 2099 Universe, The Powell) murdered him. Damek was sent through time to team up with Dreamkiller and kill Darkhawk, but upon his arrival, he discovered that Darkhawk was in fact the hero. After discovering how he was manipulated, he teamed up with Darkhawk to defeat Dreamkiller. At this point, a time portal opened, inviting him back to his own time, but he declined to go. He preferred to stay within the present-day universe and try to figure out what to do next. In that role, he once more teamed up with superheroes, this time Spider-Man, Nova, Speedball, and Savage Steel in an attack on a Mahari space cruiser, to little effect. It is unknown what has become of Damek since he last worked with Darkhawk and those other heroes.

damian bomber.name: Damian (Bomber)
damian bomber.origin: Damian was a student at Brooklyn Visions Academy, the school Miles Morales attended. Being a part of Miles' life, albeit a small one, Damian was one of the inhabitants transported to the Prime Marvel Universe following the destruction of the Ultimate Universe. Feeling that the school's lottery system was a symbol of inequality, Damian set out to destroy the academy, and eventually detonated a chemical bomb. The classroom where the bomb was detonated was evacuated by Spider-Man with Gwenpool's tiny help, and the fire was put out by the FDNY. Gwen knew about the bomber due to having originated from a world where superheroes existed in comic books, and had read an issue of Miles' comic in which one of his classmates had been set up as a bomber. With her help, Spider-Man located Damian and confronted him in his house. Gwenpool tried to kill Damian due to him being a "foul villain," but Miles saved his life. Damian was knocked in the head in the process and his mother found him in the floor, mistakenly believing he was dead. After appreheding Gwenpool, Spider-Man went back to Damian's house to check his injury and make sure his bombing plot had been effectively stopped.

fields.history: Damian was a student at Brooklyn Visions Academy, the school Miles Morales attended. Being a part of Miles' life, albeit a small one, Damian was one of the inhabitants transported to the Prime Marvel Universe following the destruction of the Ultimate Universe. Feeling that the school's lottery system was a symbol of inequality, Damian set out to destroy the academy, and eventually detonated a chemical bomb. The classroom where the bomb was detonated was evacuated by Spider-Man with Gwenpool's tiny help, and the fire was put out by the FDNY. Gwen knew about the bomber due to having originated from a world where superheroes existed in comic books, and had read an issue of Miles' comic in which one of his classmates had been set up as a bomber. With her help, Spider-Man located Damian and confronted him in his house. Gwenpool tried to kill Damian due to him being a "foul villain," but Miles saved his life. Damian was knocked in the head in the process and his mother found him in the floor, mistakenly believing he was dead. After appreheding Gwenpool, Spider-Man went back to Damian's house to check his injury and make sure his bombing plot had been effectively stopped.

damian fawcett.name: Damian Fawcett
damian fawcett.origin: Dr. Damian Fawcett was a scientist at Macroware, a subsidiary of Alchemax, who invented a program that could control the actions of people. His protégé, Carmen Lynch, used his program to force his former colleague Miguel O'Hara to kill Dr. Fawcett to take possession of his invention, but she herself was killed by Dr. Fawcett. Meanwhile Alchemax, having learned about the invention of Dr. Fawcett, sent the Rookies to Teknik building to capture the two scientists. During the confusion for the scuffle between Spider-Man, the Rookie, and the scientist, Dr. Damian was killed and the data relating to his invention destroyed.

damian link.name: Damian Link
damian link.origin: One night while on patrol, Damian and his partner, Jeff Hanley, responded to a silent alarm at a bio-genetics lab called Futura Research Laboratories. It was there he stopped his twin brother, Joshua, and some of his criminal partners from stealing equipment for their boss. During the struggle, the two brothers are thrown into an odd chamber that bombards them with experimental rays that appear to kill Damian and gives his brother ghostly white hair. Damian's partner is killed and his brother and the criminals escape the scene. Unbeknownst to the criminals, Damian survived the fall and named his brother as the murderer. This caused the criminals Joshua was working with to turn on him. This fear in Joshua triggered a newly gifted ability that allowed him to find and enter his his brother in some sort of spiritual essence. This presence then led Damian to Joshua which allowed him to save his brother before he was killed. Damian—still preserving a sense of law over family ties—chose to send his brother to prison instead of allowing him his freedom. Some time later while within prison, Joshua was able to enter Damian's body again in spirit form, only this time he could control his brother entirely and was granted the strength of both men. He did this while working as a mercenary for A.I.M. in an attempt to steal the Super-Soldier Serum that had been rediscovered. The serum was in the hands of S.H.I.E.L.D., guarded by Bobbi Morse and Ka-Zar. After stealing the serum "Damian" led Ka-Zar into the waiting arms of his brother Parnival Plunder and the monster Gog. Gemini, Gog, and Plunder fought Ka-Zar until Bobbi and Zabu arrived on a S.H.I.E.L.D. transport. Bobbi offered to buy Plunder out of the serum but he was more interested in a super army and so tasked Gog with transporting them to A.I.M.'s England base. Gog however began to disobey Plunder and transported the group to New York where Bobbi attempted to flee with the serum after Gog's rampage distracted Gemini and Plunder. Ka-Zar distracted Gemini and Plunder enough to allow Bobbi to escape but not enough to stop the pair from making an escape of their own. The next morning Josh using his brother's body made another appearance as Gemini working for Professor Conrad under the guise of Victorius after consuming A.I.M.'s supply of the super soldier serum to save himself from an explosion. Victorius and Gemini kidnapped Bobbi for her scientific expertise and took her to a New York based A.I.M. fortress. Ka-Zar knocked out Josh and when he awoke he fled the scene back to New York City where he relinquished possession of his brother Damian who is growing increasingly worried about his blackouts and what they could mean for his job as a NYPD police officer. Some time after Sergeant Damien Link visited the Avengers at their mansion to inform them of Captain America's recent arrest on request of Commissioner Nathan Martin. While at the manor however Josh took possession of his body once more on the behest of the Zodiac Cartel and used Damian's headache due to possession as an excuse to walk around the mansion. Inside the mansion Josh spots some secret plans and begins to look through them but the Swordman confronts him and ends up slashing Damian's clothing revealing the costume of Gemini. Gemini fights the Avengers but is defeated, he is rescued by the rest of Zodiac and their plan is enacted while leaving the Avengers beaten but alive. Damian's brother had also been broken out of prison at this point in time and is able to control Damian as well as his own body at the same time. Atop of the World Trade Center Zodiac built a giant Star-Blazer that they would use to kill all those born under the Gemini in Manhattan and after the deed was done they would use that fear to get whatever they wanted. A portion of Zodiac attempted a rebellion against Taurus by seeking out their organization's financer Cornelius van Lunt. Unbeknownst to them Cornelius van Lunt was Taurus and he used this knowledge to set a trap for both the Avengers and the rebelling Zodiac members by luring the two groups to an abandoned warehouse in New Jersey that was in actuality a spacecraft that would banish them into space to die. It was then Libra who snapped Damian out of his brother's control so that he could distract Taurus disguised as his brother Josh while Libra used the Zodiac's Star Craft to save the Avengers. Damian's impersonation was discovered by Taurus who quickly knocked him out before heading out to discover Libra's treachery which had him face off against the Avengers. His former teammates rather than go to jail sided with Taurus in the fight against the Avengers but all of Zodiac was defeated.

damon larsen.name: Damon Larsen
damon larsen.origin: Prior to enlisting in the United States Army, Larsen claims to have killed several men, women and even some children. During basic training Larsen was assigned to Sgt. Luke Evans' all black platoon. After losing the secrets of the Super Soldier Serum with the death of Dr. Erskine, the United States Army still wanted to produce more Super Soldiers like Steve Rogers. Col. Walker Price and Dr. Wilfred Nagel forcibly recruited Larsen and 300 other African-American solders to serve as test subjects to recreate the Super Soldier Serum. To keep the operation secret, families were sent letters informing them of the soldiers deaths. left|thumb|200px|The Black Super Soldiers Of the 300 African-American soldiers, only a handful of men survived the gruesome process, including Larsen. These survivors became a convert black ops team. Although Larsen was the first to survive the experimental Serum, he died during one of their first missions when a grenade exploded at his feet.
abilities: Larsen was trained in unarmed combat by the US Army.

damon malone.name: Damon Malone
damon malone.origin: When he was a young man Damon Malone became obsessed with fire, lighting things on fire for his personal amusement, and took great pleasure in lighting on fire the belongings of his younger sister Magda. One day, Damon lit a club house on fire leading to a scuffle with another neighbourhood boy named Eric Hodges. During the fight, Damon was knocked into the fire and was horribly burned before he was pulled out. Growing to adulthood, the horribly scarred Damon cut all ties with his family and relocated to an island on the Pacific. There he grew out his hair and a massive beard to hide his scarred face. Obtaining a submarine and a crew he became an area pirate dubbed the Firebrand, for his knack for robbing ships and then lighting them on fire. The island region lived in fear of the Firebrand and sought to avoid his wrath. By 1948, the now adult Magda was a famous aviator along with her husband-to-be, Eric Hodges. However, before she was to marry she wanted to find her long-lost brother, unaware of his transformation into Firebrand. While out looking for him, he plane was downed over his island and Damon took her prisoner, Magda unaware of the fact that Firebrand was her brother. Meanwhile, Eric began searching for her when she was reported missing. Firebrand and his crew went out to rob another ship, lighting it afire when they were finished. The attack was spotted by Sub-Mariner and Namora who forced Firebrand's sub to surface when they opened the hatch in an attempt to flood it. Firebrand and his crew attacked the two Atlanteans and managed to subdue them. Firebrand then had them tied to a torpedo and launched to their doom and escaped, unaware that he two heroes broke free before the torpedo could detonate. Back on his island, Firebrand mocked his sister when his men suddenly brought in Eric, who had managed to track Magda down to Firebrand's island. Eric recognizing Firebrand's scars identified him as Magda's long lost brother. Firebrand then had the pair tied to a stake and was prepared to burn them alive when Namor and Namora arrived on the scene. While the heroes were busy saving Magda and Eric and fighting off Firebrand's men, the pyromaniac attempted to flee. Namor caught up to the villain just as he arrived as his sub. Firebrand then attempted to keep Namor at bay with a thermite bomb, but tripped over a rope and fell onto his sub, the thermite then went off burning him alive, ending his menace.
weapons: Firebrand used thermite bombs to start his fires.
weaknesses: Firebrand suffered from , a impulsive disorder that causes him to deliberately light fires for his own gratification.

damon morelle.name: Damon Morelle
damon morelle.origin: Damon Morelle was the founder and president of Morelle Pharmaceuticals, one of the largest biomedical corporations in the United States. Although publicly renowned for its cutting-edge medical research, the company secretly conducted highly unethical experiments involving nanotechnology, cybernetics, genetic engineering, and temporal physics. Morelle's scientific pursuits were initially driven by a deeply personal tragedy. His son, Nolan Morelle, suffered from a rare degenerative skin disease that required constant skin grafts and intensive medical treatment. Determined to save his son, Morelle invested enormous resources into developing an artificial, self-regenerating skin through the company's Project: Sharkskin. As his research progressed, Morelle's ambitions expanded beyond medicine. Sharkskin evolved into a revolutionary nanotechnological bio-armor capable of self-repair, adaptive camouflage, and direct neural integration with its wearer. At the same time, Morelle Pharmaceuticals began developing advanced military technologies and investigating the manipulation of time itself. To protect his research, Morelle employed covert operatives known as the Silent Shadows, who eliminated competitors and attempted to silence anyone threatening the corporation's secrets, including Kevin Trench, the vigilante known as Nightwatch. He later deployed the technologically enhanced Camouflage Cadre, whose experimental stealth armor represented the next generation of Sharkskin-derived technology. Morelle also financed corporate espionage to acquire competing scientific discoveries. Among these operations was the theft of cardiologist Dr. Elias Wirtham's experimental research, which was subsequently weaponized through the creation of the cybernetic assassin known as Cardiaxe. Eventually, Morelle established an orbital research station where Project: Sharkskin and his temporal experiments reached their final stages. Unknown to most of his associates, many of his operations were financially supported by the mysterious organization known as the Fold, whose members intended to exploit Morelle's discoveries for military and political domination. The culmination of Morelle's research ultimately led to a catastrophic future in which the perfected Sharkskin technology and temporal experimentation resulted in widespread devastation. In an effort to prevent this timeline, an older version of Nolan Morelle traveled back through time alongside the future version of Nightwatch's bio-armor. During the confrontation aboard Morelle's orbital facility, Damon Morelle was killed, bringing an end to his plans and allowing history to be altered before the catastrophe could occur.
