dan harper.name: Dan Harper
dan harper.origin: Dan Harper was travelling on a ship which sank in the Pacific. The rest of the crew and passengers escaped in lifeboats, but Dan ended up clinging to a piece of driftwood and was washed up days later on an isolated island where he encountered a beautiful woman who begged him to help her open a box which she claimed contained her fortune. Dan levered the box open, only to learn that the woman was Pandora and in opening her box, he had freed a creature which she intended to use to conquer the Earth. Dan fortunately was able to escape to Australia and returned with the authorities, bearing mirrors which they erected around Pandora while she slept. The mirrors destroyed Pandora's illusion of beauty and revealed her true age and appearance, a sight which she could not bear. Pandora agreed to imprison her creature once more in return for the removal of the mirrors, and Dan and the Australian authorities left her on her island, taking the box with them in order to bury it where it would never be found.

dan hawk.name: Dan Hawk
dan hawk.origin: Dan Hawk was the son of Jim Hawk, a member of the Texas Rangers during the days of the American Frontier. In 1836, Jim was among the many Rangers that were involved in the Battle of the Alamo, at some point during the conflict Jim was shot dead leaving Dan orphaned. Dan was left in the care of Cactus an old family friend who promised to look after Dan should anything happen to his father. Cactus then taught Dan how to shoot and ride and soon the young teen became a proficient gunslinger. Seeking to follow in his father's footsteps, Dan sought membership in the Texas Rangers but was denied due to the fact that he was still too young to join their ranks. This changed when Dan and Cactus heard how a band of renegade Native Americans led by chief Wassati were attacking the fort after obtaining guns. When the warriors were forced to retreat after running out of ammo, Dan and Cactus tracked down their supplier and tied him up they then secured his wagon of ammunition. Dan then went to the native camp and began shooting and lured them out to where he laid a trap with gun powder, starting a ring a fire to keep them trapped. Dan then fought Wassati one-on-one and won just as the Texas Rangers arrived on the scene. Impressed by Dan's work, the captain offered Dan a position with the Rangers. However the experience changed Dan's opinion and he decided instead to travel around Texas helping those in need. The captain accepted this offer and made Dan an honorary and undercover Texas Ranger. Dan Hawk rode across Texas for years and by the time he was an adult he became known as the "Kid from Texas". With the help of his trusty sidekick Cactus, the Kid From Texas rounded up an outlaw named McLean, and captured the Blackie Craig gang after a series of coach robberies. Later the Kid and Cactus liberated the town of Laredo from Lash Grogan and his gang, exposed Mr. Carter of Copper City was the mastermind behind a series of coach robberies. Later the pair were captured by Red Claw and his band of Native Americans who convinced chief Chippawa that the Kid was an enemy. However the Kid and Cactus broke free and foiled Red Claw's attempt to assassinate Chippawa and frame the Kid for it. The Kid then agreed to pretend to be implicated in ringleader of a coach robbery in Twin Forks in an attempt to flush out the real thieves. Cactus, unaware of this plan insisted that the Kid was innocent and even broke Dan out of jail to capture the real thieves before learning the truth. Subsequent adventures of the Kid From Texas remain unrecorded.
weapons: Dan carried two six shooters.

dan hurley.name: Dan Hurley
dan hurley.origin: Dan Hurley was a private detective who employed Betty Barstow in the 1940s. One night, while Hurley and Barstow were working late, Dan would get a frantic phone call from Greggs Hansen the caretaker at Woodline Cemetery. Hansen would be convinced that the cemetery was haunted by ghosts, however Dan would not be convinced and would wearily hang up on the old man. Betty however would not be convinced and her employers apathy to Hansen's claims would lead to her becoming the costumed heroine known as the Silver Scorpion. As the Silver Scorpion, Betty would reveal that the "ghosts" were really counterfeiters that were operating in secret from the cemetery. After their capture, Dan would be impressed by the Silver Scorpions capture, unaware that she was in reality his own secretary.
abilities: Was presumably an expert detective.
weaknesses: His abilities as a detective would sometimes be clouded by his perceptions of people calling for his aid. He was also incapable of deducing that his secretary was the Silver Scorpion.

dan sekowsky.name: Dan Sekowsky
dan sekowsky.origin: Dan Sekowsky was a bank robber known as Snake-Eye who was active in 1944. During one of his robberies, he and his accomplice were pursued by the Whizzer after they had robbed a bank. They attempted to escape by barging into the lab of inventor Professor Branebig. They stole Branebig's prototype rocket that he believed could carry a man to the moon. Warned too late, Snake-Eye and his accomplice thought they had escaped to the moon, when in reality they crash-landed in a nearby swamp. When the Whizzer attempted to capture them, Dr. Branebig attempted to assist in the capture by arriving on the scene on his flying motorcycle. Snake-Eye managed to pull Branebig from his motorcycle and escape with his accomplice again and robbed yet another bank. However, their downfall came at the assistance of Branebig who pulled the flying motorcycle back to his lab with a super-magnet. There, the Whizzer subdued them with the assistance of Branebig's "burglar catcher" device, and he was turned over to the authorities. The subsequent fate of Snake-Eye is unknown.
weapons: Snake-Eye carried a pistol.

dan trent.name: Dan Trent
dan trent.origin: Dan Trent was a psychiatrist expert in the treatment of claustrophobia to whom his friend Fred Dens sent one of his employees, Alan Ohm, who suffered exaggeratedly from it. After several sessions, where under hypnosis he was unable to go back in Alan's memories except for a single year, the psychiatrist tried to use a private investigator to discover his past, but the investigator also failed to find traces of Ohm. By insisting on hypnosis sessions, he managed to go back to the most distant memory of Ohm, and by having him draw it, it turned out that he had been reincarnated and the fact of having been closed in a coffin was the cause of his strong claustrophobia.

dan westmeyer.name: Dan Westmeyer
dan westmeyer.origin: Dan Westmeyer was one of Empire State University's administrators. He attended the demonstration for Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S.' Catalyst during a symposium on renewable resources at E.S.U. The demonstration was interrupted by the Lethal Legion, who trapped the five hundred spectators and murdered several of them during their attempt to steal the Catalyst. The massacre was stopped by the Sin-Eater, who seemingly murdered all the villains, prompting applause from the spectators, including Westmeyer. After the incident, Westmeyer was interviewed by reporter Norah Winters for Threats and Menaces. He admitted he would have felt ashamed of applauding if the event had happened years prior, but argued present times were dangerous.

dancing water.name: Dancing Water
dancing water.species: Human with powers of unknown origin
dancing water.origin: Dancing Water was the illegitimate daughter of Avalanche (Dominikos Petrakis) and a member of Red Skull's S-Men. She, along with the rest of her team, removed Professor X's body from his mausoleum in order to allow their leader to take part of his brain and give himself telepathic powers, taking prisoner Rogue and Scarlet Witch in the process. While imprisoned, Rogue managed to establish contact with Dancing Water and absorb her water-based powers to escape captivity, only to be re-captured and taken to New York City. Dancing Water attempted to have Rogue and Scarlet Witch beaten by a mind-controlled lynch mob until they were rescued by the Uncanny Avengers. Dancing Water and most of the other S-Men were later killed by Magneto.

dane gavin.name: Dane Gavin
dane gavin.origin: Dr. Dane Gavin was a scientist and expedition leader hired by Vivian Schist to capture or destroy the Man-Thing following the disappearance of F.A. Schist in the Florida Everglades. Rather than killing the creature outright, Gavin devised a method of containing it within a specialized electrified sphere capable of incapacitating the swamp-being without permanently harming it. With the Man-Thing subdued, Gavin transported the creature to New York City, where it was displayed at the Museum of Natural History as a scientific curiosity. The exhibition quickly turned catastrophic, however, when the fear and panic of museum visitors triggered the Man-Thing’s empathic nature, driving it into a destructive rampage through the city. Even Mister Fantastic of the Fantastic Four proved unable to halt the creature’s advance. As the situation worsened, Gavin discovered that prolonged separation from the swamp ecosystem was causing the Man-Thing to weaken and slowly die. Persuaded in part by Carolyn Schist’s pleas, Gavin ultimately agreed to return the creature to the Everglades. Following the ordeal, he remained fascinated by the Man-Thing and resolved to continue studying it, but only within its natural swamp habitat rather than in captivity.

dangerous doll.name: Dangerous Doll
dangerous doll.origin: A man down on his luck is incredibly upset at not being able to afford a gift for his lame daughter on her eighth birthday. He was walking alone through the backwoods feeling sorry for himself, when he comes upon what appeared to be a strange-looking doll. The man begins to think that his luck is finally changing, as the doll would make the perfect gift for his girl. It turns out that the girl does indeed love her new toy, but when the father is not around the doll astoundingly walks and talks all on its own. It asks the girl for food and water, which she quickly fetches for her prize toy. She tries to convince her father of the doll's feats, but he believes her to be making the stories up. The doll is actually not a doll at all, but rather a small alien child who has gotten lost on the planet Earth and is waiting for his parents to find him. One night, when he senses that his parents are near, he uses his cosmic powers to put both the girl and father to sleep while he sneaks outside to find his parents. When they asked him where he had been staying, the small child tells his parents of the kindness of the young girl in looking after him. The father, therefore, uses his own powers to cure the girl's lameness and plants a gold ingot in her bed to financially help her and her father.
powers: The Dangerous Doll could fire a beam of cosmic energy from his hands which was able to cause humans to go to sleep. He could also mysteriously sense the presence of his parents over a distance.

dangor.name: Dangor
dangor.origin: Dangor is an alien who lives on an unidentified world that exists in the Inniverse, a dimension that exists parallel to Earth's that is located by breaching the proper occupational frequency to allow passage between the distances between atoms and molecules that comprise of matter. He was a member of the Gem Guild, an upper class society that utilized "Gem-Talented" to utilize the power of gems that ring their planet. When a young orphan named Occulus was discovered to be a powerful Gem-Talented individual, Dangor saw personally to the boy's training. As it turned out Occulus was one such adept and incidentally the most powerful. Reaching the end of his studies, Occulus became the most powerful gem wielder of the realm. To cement his power, Occulus cut out his right eye and replaced it with a gem in which he could focus his power, he took Dangor as his advisor. After taking a wife named Landa, Occulus become a ruler of his world, he saved the people of their world but later became a tyrant. Wildblood meanwhile, became part of the resistance seeking to overthrow the rule of Occulus. During one of his wife's protests, Occulus used his power to sear off her left hand. While on a mission to steal some gems, Wildblood witnessed as the hand belonging to the Fantastic Four's Mister Fantastic breached the barrier between worlds. When he was later found by the Gem Guild, he saw the hand pierce their realm again and used it to escape to Earth. There Wildblood battled it out with members of the Fantastic Four and was incapacitated. However, members of the Gem Guild followed Wildblood to Earth, and discovering that Mister Fantastic and the Invisible Woman's son Franklin was Gem-Talented, captured him, the Invisible Woman and Wildblood before returning to their own dimension. Wildblood, Sue, and Franklin were brought before Occulus and it was here that Dangor revealed to his leader that the Richards child was an even more powerful adept at commanding the power of the gems. Although Occulus saw the boy as a threat, Dangor convinced his master to use the boy as a matrix to utilize the power of all the gems on their world. As Sue and Wildblood escaped captivity, the matrix was constructed. Sue came back for her son alone, battling against Occulus and almost won had it not been for Dangor threatening to slit her child's throat. This allowed Occulus to defeat her and activate the machine. Ultimately, the rest of the Fantastic Four arrived with Wildblood and his rebels and attacked Occulus. During this battle, Mister Fantastic attempted to overload Occulus with his Gemenervator device, but Occulus managed to destroy it before it could finish its task, gaining absolute power. Consumed with power, Occulus lashed out against his foes as well as his own people. This led to Landa betraying her husband to help the Fantastic Four defeat him. Utilizing the matrix device Occulus had created, Reed refitted it to emit a negative charge that send Occulus rapidly flying out of orbit and into space. With Occulus defeated, he was left in the custody of Wildblood and his rebels. The subsequent fate of Dangor is unknown at this time.

daniel angel.name: Daniel (Angel)
daniel angel.origin: Daniel was an angel from Heaven, the brother of Kazaan and little brother of Malachi. During Lucifer's rebellion, Daniel and Malachi remained loyal to the Throne while their other brother Kazaan fell with Lucifer. Malachi and Kazaan remained in contact in the millennia that followed, feeding information to each other in the war between Heaven and Hell to ensure their favor and promotion in their respective jobs. Unfortunately, Kazaan made his own plans and intended to manifest physically on Earth, drawing unwanted attention to Malachi. Malachi went to Daniel for help shutting Kazaan down while maintaining some plausible deniability to all sides about his involvement. Daniel directed him to Johnny Blaze, the Ghost Rider -- an incredibly powerful, and incredibly gullible pawn for Malachi to exploit.
weapons: Heavenly Sword

daniel andrews.name: Daniel Andrews
daniel andrews.origin: Happy Dan Andrews was an inmate at the Ravencroft Institute's maximum security wing, and one of the many infected by Carnage to aid in his quest to retrieve symbiote codices. Together with Spider-Man (Miles Morales), who had been infected with a symbiote himself, Happy Dan was sent to kill J. Jonah Jameson. During their mission, Spider-Man used the psychic link between symbiotes to communicate with Dan and try to get him to reclaim control of his body. After Miles managed to strip himself off his symbiote, Dan attacked him out of jealousy that he was free. When Miles' symbiote bonded to Jameson and went after Miles, he knocked Dan out of the building where they were fighting. After evading Jameson, Spider-Man checked up on Dan to see if he had survived the fall. Once he was reassured he was alive, Miles webbed him up until authorities arrived.

daniel axum.name: Daniel Axum
daniel axum.origin: As the costumed supervillain the Battler, Danny Broughton sought to make a better life for himself and his family, using the proceeds of his crimes to buy his parents a new home in Hempstead, Long Island. However, all of that came crashing down after a string of highly publicized defeats, culminating in a brutal defeat at the hands of Spider-Man, which left Broughton with a severe injury to his left eye and a host of criminal charges. After selling the Hempstead house, Broughton was able to hire a team of lawyers who cut down his sentence to three years. While in prison, Danny's father died and his estranged girlfriend, Gina, gave him a son, Benny. Danny himself had his last name legally changed to Axum, to reflect his African heritage. After being released, Danny moved in with his mother in Hoboken and found a job with the Griswold Construction company, but had trouble keeping up with rent and child support, and struggled to stay in good graces with his parole officer, Mr. Eales. Desperate for money, he turned to shady promoter Rey Trueno, who offered him a job fighting in the superhuman fighting federation called the Ultimate Brawling League. In his first fight, Axum handily defeated Armadillo, becoming the New Jersey Regional Champion. The title, and the money that came with it, helped Axum pay off his bills and restore his self-confidence, and through this, helped him rekindle his relationship with Gina. Training with Coach Cady, Axum continued to win, eventually quitting his day job and devoting himself full-time to fighting. After a long battle with the Vladivostok-born brawler Slag, Axum was declared the Ultimate Brawling World Champion. Afterwards, he was contacted by one of his fellow fighters, Man-Killer, who offered him a place in her Spider-Man Revenge Squad. Axum, who still held a grudge against Spider-Man for scarring his face, almost considered joining her, but then came across Armadillo, who'd been living in an alley ever since his defeat. Armadillo convinced him that holding a grudge and getting revenge would not help him, and thus Axum decided to decline Man-Killer's offer. Axum's activities since then are unknown, although he and Trueno had a falling out after Axum won the World Championship, so his future with the UBL is uncertain.
abilities: Hand-to-Hand Combat: Axum is a skilled hand-to-hand fighter.
weaknesses: Damaged Eye: Axum suffered a dramatic injury to his left eye during his fight with Spider-Man which compromised his sight.

daniel bascom.name: Daniel Bascom
daniel bascom.origin: Daniel "King" Bascom was a wealthy banker whose greed led him to attempt to gain full control over America's farm land. To this end, he invested his money in a machine that would cause drought conditions to nearby farms, driving them out of business and forcing them to sell their land at low prices. He would then purchase the properties, which he intended to revitalize and gain control of the farming industry. However, calls to the F.B.I led to them sending their agent Curt Cowan to investigate. Unknown to all, Cowan was secretly the crime fighter known as the Dynamic Man. Using his x-ray vision, he found the location of the drought causing machine and smashed it up. Learning of Bascom's involvement, the Dynamic Man chased after Bascom and eventually captured him before forcing him to confess to his crimes when turned over to the authorities.

daniel blaire.name: Daniel Blaire
daniel blaire.first_appearance: Peter Parker, The Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 122
daniel blaire.origin: Danny Blaire was the son of a prostitute named Sharon Blaire had with Brendan Doyle, the super-powered mercenary better known as the Mauler. Sharon conceived Danny without Brendan's knowledge. When he learned of Danny's existence, he tried to take him, hoping to have something for himself that wasn't his unfulfilling mercenary life. He confronted Sharon, but she dropped the baby off her first-floor apartment window and into a dumpster to keep him away from Doyle. Spider-Man's civilian alter ego of Peter Parker stumbled into the baby, he fended off Brendan when he tried to claim it, and took the infant to St. Vincent's Hospital. After being denied a visit because he had no parental rights, Doyle suited up as the Mauler and stormed the hospital, fighting Spider-Man in the process. Doyle managed to shake off the hero and take off with Danny, but found himself in a stand-off with the police. Doyle intended to use the baby as a human shield, and Spider-Man convinced him that meant he wouldn't put the kid before himself. Realizing that maybe it was too late for him, the Mauler placed the baby on the ground and took off. When Danny was five years old, he died in a bus collision.

daniel brantson.name: Daniel Brantson
daniel brantson.origin: Daniel Brantson, alias Troubleshooter, was an international superhuman mercenary with ties to the US government. The Advisor, a mysterious individual who may have demonic powers, escalated hostilities in San Revilla (a Central American country) to the point of causing a civil war. For his own purposes, the Advisor concluded that it was essential to use superhumans in the conflict, and ensured that the Shadows, a rebel insurgent group, had its elite parahuman unit; but, wanting to corrupt innocents, the Advisor manipulated former Avenger Hawkeye, into leading and training the Shadows, making him believe that the U.S. State Department supported the rebel faction against the fascist government militia (While Hawkeye intended the Shadows to use non-lethal force, in reality the Shadows were killing troops and civilians behind Hawkeye's back, perpetuating their dangerous image). At the same time, the Advisor ensured that government troops had specialized equipment, funding, personnel, and advanced technology, also with US backing. The Advisor then recruited three superhumans for the government including Hazzerd and Troubleshooter, supposedly on the recommendation of the US government, and the U.S.Agent, another Avenger who believed he was working for the US Commission on Superhuman Affairs to take on rogue terrorists. They all met with the Advisor for their briefing at government headquarters in Ciudad Revilla. The Shadows received orders to attack the Preto airstrip, supposedly because it was being used to "ship in foreign mercenaries for the government," when in fact it was being used for refugee flights out of the country. The American superhero War Machine, who had infiltrated San Revilla for other reasons and had discovered the Advisor's involvement, went to Preto to try and defuse the situation by speaking with his friend Hawkeye, but before he could do so, the government's superhuman agents (Hazzerd, Troubleshooter, and U.S.Agent) arrived with support troops. The mere presence of Hawkeye and War Machine made U.S.Agent reconsider the situation, not wanting to confront people whose morals he trusted, but Hazzerd attacked Hawkeye to fulfill his contract, starting a fight especially since the Shadows were ready to fight too. War Machine damaged Troubleshooter's armor; Striker suckerpunched U.S.Agent, Hazzerd pummeled Hawkeye - but eventually U.S.Agent realized they had all been manipulated, and convinced Hawkeye to listen to War Machine. Hawkeye then stunned Striker and then went after Sundance, since he had trained him and knew his tricks; while War Machine used concussive pulses to control the non-superpowered troops. Troubleshooter threatened to use a still-operational cannon, but War Machine disabled it with an electromagnetic sweep; U.S.Agent defeated Hazzerd, and Hawkeye defeated Sundance. Once the heroes won the battle, a huge vision of the Advisor appeared, acknowledging that they had thwarted his plans but also attempting to intimidate them and swearing revenge; However, War Machine countered to the Advisor that since his power depended on manipulating others and humans were fast learners, the Advisor had not only lost that day, but would lose many more times in the future. Hawkeye, Luke, U.S.Agent, and War Machine left San Revilla the next day, apparently having ended the civil war. The Advisor's involvement was reported to the American government.
weaknesses: Troubleshooter's armor was of poor quality compared to the War Machine model

daniel brock.name: Daniel Brock
daniel brock.origin: Dan Brock was a character of Eddie Brock's past fabricated into his memories by the Venom symbiote as part of its efforts to make Eddie stay with it. In these altered memories, Dan Brock was the brother of Carl Brock and uncle of Eddie and Mary Brock. He died of terminal cancer when they were young. These forged memories caused Eddie to recall having been left traumatized due to watching his uncle waste away in front of him. When the Venom symbiote had Eddie retroactively believe that he was seeking to commit suicide in the Our Lady of Saints Church because he had discovered he had cancer, the memories of Dan became one of the reasons Eddie believed he was scared of the illness. When Eddie fell prey to the Maker and he attempted to separate the symbiote from Eddie, their psychic connection began failing. This resulted in Venom's influence in Eddie's memories fading away, causing him to realize that he had never had an uncle named Dan.

family: Jamie Brock (sister-in-law, deceased) Anne Weying (ex-niece-in-law, deceased)
Eddie Brock (nephew) Mary Brock (niece, deceased) Dylan Brock (great-nephew)

daniel chilton.name: Daniel Chilton
daniel chilton.origin: Daniel Chilton was 19 years old super hero who lived in Madison, Wisconsin. He wanted to join the Avengers. During the events of Fear Itself, a deranged Purifier leader believed not just mutants were responsible for "the end of the world", but all super-people. The leader, Jonathan Standish, kidnapped Daniel Chilton and held him hostage, broadcasting live online about the hero's capture. Standish told everyone watching that demons were coming for their souls and that the only way to defy them and still reach heaven, according to Standish, was to kill themselves. Standish then killed Daniel as a sacrifice, and pleaded for everyone out there to kill themselves as well.
powers: He could create light holograms.

daniel connor.name: Daniel Connor
daniel connor.first_appearance: Elektra and Wolverine: The Redeemer Vol 1 1
daniel connor.origin: Dr. Daniel Connor worked for or with Department K and/or the Weapon X Program as he was able to attain DNA from Wolverine during the time when he part of Weapon X and was bonded to Adamantium. With his wife, Veronica, they used Wolverine's DNA to genetically engineer their daughter Avery. These activities were overseen by their supervisor, Kiefer. As Avery grew, her parents began to have recriminations. At age 6, they began devising a scheme to escape from under Kiefer's control This involved simulating a breakdown of their marriage and trial separation. Kiefer, aware of their true plans, hired Elektra to assassinate both parents. Daniel had recently moved to Manhattan as part of the plan to escape Kiefer's control. Elektra found him there and murdered him in his sleep.

daniel damian.name: Daniel Damian
daniel damian.origin: Dr. Daniel Damian was an archaeologist and father of Margo Damian. During an expedition on a tropical island, he discovered a hidden Kree base, guarded by Sentry 459. He and his assistant were imprisoned by the Sentry and saved by the Fantastic Four. Later, Daniel hired a cameraman named Ike Harris (actually the Eternal known as Ikaris) to guide him and his daughter, Margo, through the ruins of an Incan temple in the Andes Mountains and document the event. When they arrived at the ruins, they discovered an immense God Chamber filled with artifacts and technological wonders unlike anything else found on Earth. Ikaris revealed his true heritage to Dr. Damian and his daughter and activated a cosmic beacon to summon the great Celestials. Damian was present when the Deviant overlord Kro invaded the temple and challenged the approaching "Gods." He was also witness to the resurrection of Ajak and the arrival of the Fourth Celestial Host. Arishem the Judge set down in the City of the Space Gods where it was decreed he would stand in judgment over Earth for a span of fifty years. Upon his arrival, the City of the Space Gods was sealed off from the rest of humanity. Ikaris and Margo Damian managed to escape before they were trapped for half a century, but Dr. Damian, unwilling to see the treasures of the Incan past, lost forever, elected to stay behind. After the murder of his daughter Margo, Dr. Damian wanted revenge against Deviants and Eternals. To this end, he planted false prophecies about the twin offspring of Eternals and Deviants conquering the two races and mutated Ajak into a monster who began killing human sets of twins. Later, he had Thena and Kro's twins, Donald and Deborah Ritter, kidnapped in the hopes he could have their parents witness their demise. Ikaris discovered his friend's betrayal and with the Eternals confronted Dr. Damian. Ajak, disgusted with what Damian had turned him into, killed himself and Damian by exploding.
abilities: Archeology: Dr. Daniel Damian was an expert in the field of archaeology (as evidenced by the fact that he held a doctorate).

daniel decriscio.name: Daniel DeCriscio
daniel decriscio.origin: Daniel DeCriscio was a hitman for the Italian Mafia. He was known as "the Deathbringer" in the press for being, at the time, the most prolific and brutal hitman of all time. When he was sent to kill the head of the Chinatown Triads, the man's wife and 2-month-old daughter turned out to be at home. After killing the baby's parents, she was entrusted to Daniel. Growing up as Lyla DeCriscio, Daniel raised her in a cruel way; he made her fight on the streets for her own food, and never gave her anything. While Daniel never abused her physically, he didn't allow her to sleep or eat until she trained. Daniel taught her to kill before she even hit puberty, and by the time she was twenty years old, Lyla had killed almost a hundred people, and worked together with Daniel. When she was old enough, Lyla killed Daniel in revenge for the death of her biological parents.

daniel dillon.name: Daniel Dillon
daniel dillon.origin: Trying to stop the destruction of reality following Fixer's death by his future self, the Thunderbolts tried to identify among the people who died following the appearance of the Thunderbolts Tower to compare on their database what their true fate would have been without that event, and among the identified corpses was that of Daniel Dillon who, compared with the database, resulted in having disappeared around that date, but in fact the corpse was there, so the Thunderbolts remedied this discrepancy by making the corpse of Daniel Dillon and all the others who had suffered the same fate disappear.

daniel dubois.name: Daniel DuBois
daniel dubois.origin: thumb|left Daniel DuBois is the son of Princess Python, brought up in upper-class New York City. While attending school, Daniel met Kate Bishop, and later recognized her during a battle between the Young Avengers and the Young Masters. Daniel's alter ego of the Executioner is a member of the Young Masters of Evil, and he is still in contact with his mother, who funds his activities, but it is unknown how aware she is of this. Later on, Executioner blew up his mother's car after discovering her criminal lifestyle. ===Vengeance=== Leading the Young Masters in an attack on Latveria, Executioner was captured. He was later apparently freed, as he was seen among the Masters of Evil.
abilities: Executioner doesn't have any superhuman powers, but is skilled with several weapons, including 2 pistols and a sniper.

family: Zelda DuBois (mother) Wilbur Day (father or stepfather)

daniel edge.name: Daniel Edge
daniel edge.first_appearance: Further Adventures of Cyclops and Phoenix Vol 1 1
daniel edge.origin: In 1859, Danny, who had stopped talking after witnessing the murder of his parents, was kidnapped by a group of Marauders, who captured freaks, fools, and all types of misshapen folk off the streets of London and took them underground. Dr. Nathaniel Essex hired the thugs to continue their work, so he could perform experiments on the victims in the name of science. Salvation came, in the form of the time-travelers, Cyclops and Phoenix, who thwarted En Sabah Nur and Mister Sinister's plan to conquer the United Kingdom, so Oscar Stamp took Daniel journeyed to America to start a new life. At the immigration office, they claimed to be father and son, by the name of Summers, inspired by the married couple that had saved them from their fates. In America, Daniel met and married a woman, Amanda Müeller, and, after a string of miscarriages and his wife being labeled the Black Womb, they had one child. Still obsessed with the Summers' bloodline, Sinister operated an obstetrics facility, Essex Clinic, in New York, in the late 19th century, and performed side research on society's deviants, including the adult Daniel and his wife. After even more miscarriages with his wife, Daniel ultimately left his family.

daniel french.name: Daniel French
daniel french.origin: Daniel "Danny" French was a mercenary for hire, doing whatever it took to get a job done, and used whatever he could to enhance his personal gain. His earliest recorded escapades had him employed by Damon Dran to collect a device called Project 4, an energy globe of incalculable power. During his mission with the Black Widow to obtain this device, it became apparent that their employer intended to double-cross them, and so Danny took the globe into his possession and used it to blackmail those he sought to gain from. In more recent history, during the time when the Black Widow had relocated to San Francisco with lawyer Matt Murdock (aka Daredevil), Danny French attempted to contact the Widow. The two eventually resolved to deal with Project 4, the one mission they left outstanding, however, the two were captured by their former employer. Dran then brainwashed the Widow to attack Daredevil and then extract the location of the globe from Danny's mind. Dran then used the power of the globe to become the Indestructible Man. Danny was freed by Daredevil but nobly sacrificed his life by smashing the globe. Depowering Dran, both were seemingly killed in the resulting explosion. Dran has since resurfaced alive and well due to the powers he gained from the globe.
abilities: Danny is an accomplished spy, mercenary, and blackmailer. He is well trained in various fighting styles, and weapons.

daniel glidewell.name: Daniel Glidewell
daniel glidewell.origin: Little is detailed about Danny's life before the zombie plague arrived on Earth-2149, however he was somehow rescued by Magneto and kept safe with an ever-decreasing band of survivors in the New York subway system. When Magneto returned from a sortie to find medicines and supplies with another meta-human from another reality. Danny was understandably cautious, but his daughter reassured him. They learned from Reed that there was a teleportation device in the Baxter Building and made a plan to escape using it. Just then, a super-powered zombie horde crashed into the subway station, and they had to make a dash for the rear exit to have any hope of escaping to Reed's universe. Outside the back door, an even bigger mass of zombies waits for them, but right on time, Reed's friends arrived. Sue temporarily blinded the horde, while Johnny and Ben burned and clobbered a path through to the Baxter Building, where the survivors escaped using the teleport, leaving behind Magneto to destroy the device.

daniel johnston.name: Daniel Johnston
daniel johnston.origin: Daniel Johnston was once a police detective, working alongside his partner Abraham Varley. They had both been on the police force for over ten years and were regarded as crooked cops, because they also worked for the Kingpin of Crime Wilson Fisk. One of their main jobs for the Kingpin was to regularly rouse Alfredo Morelli, who was a friend of the Kingpin's son Richard Fisk. One day Morelli told Varley and Johnston that it would be better to work for him. Johnston then joined Richard Fisk's payroll and became one of the Rose's right hand henchmen. On the Rose's instructions and along with Mr. Varley they once bribed football player Ray Nesters to throw a game. Wendy Thorton who was a sports columnist for the Daily Bugle was able to uncover corruption in football when she interviewed Nesters. Mr. Johnston once shot Daniel Kingsley when the Rose decided they should tie up loose ends. Following this and after a major Gang War, Johnston was killed by the Hobgoblin and his body found by the Rose resting in an armchair. His partner Varley was also found hanging from the roof of the Rose's apartment.

daniel kiku.name: Daniel Kiku
daniel kiku.origin: Danny Fear was the leader of the Yakuza's science division, the Shogun Reapers, who were building a cannon on the Moon with the ability to fire a ray in a frequency capable of controlling the Earth's plate tectonics. thumb|left When S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Nick Fury Jr. broke into the base, Danny Fear dispatched countless Shogun Reapers to stop the intruder. He later confronted Fury personally together with two of his agents, all outfitted in shogun mechas. Fury hacked into the suit of Akihiko with his Prototype Eyepatch and had him fight Danny Fear while he slipped away to another room. Akihiko was then forced to fire at a window, decompressing the room, and causing all three Shogun Reapers to be swallowed by the vacuum of space. A shuttle was later launched by remaining Shogun Reapers to retrieve Danny Fear, who remained floating in space safely inside the mecha.

daniel leffers.origin: Dan Leffers was the incompetent court-appointed attorney who represented Rage when he was put in trial for a pawn shop robbery he didn't commit and for which he was brutally arrested by the Americops. Rage refused to ask for professional help, deciding to use his situation to make a statement and show the injustice in the American judicial system. As expected, Leffers' performance during the trial was lackluster, and Rage was found guilty.

daniel leighton.name: Daniel Leighton
daniel leighton.origin: ===Early Life=== Daniel "Danny" Leighton was born in Austin, Texas. He was later a member of the Savage Crimes, a New York street gang, as a youth. The leader of the gang was a young man called Brock, who later became the costumed assassin Crossbones. Brock was responsible for beating and possibly raping Danny's sister Rachel when she attempted to join the gang. ===Cutthroat=== Leighton later became an assassin known as Cutthroat. He was hired by Amos Jardine to kill the superhero Spider-Man, in place of the eccentric assassin Arcade. Cutthroat battled the mutant hero Nightcrawler, who had discovered the plan, and Spider-Man, and the heroes defeated him with covert assistance from Arcade himself. thumb|left ===Skeleton Crew=== Many years later, Cutthroat defeated Mangler and Deathstroke in a fight to the death to become the Red Skull's new chief operative in his Skeleton Crew, replacing Crossbones. He received additional training with Taskmaster to improve his combat skills. Cutthroat tried to persuade his fellow Skeleton Crew members Blackwing and Jack O'Lantern to help him free their teammate Mother Night from police custody. Cutthroat soon had a brief affair with Mother Night, despite the fact that she was the Red Skull's mistress. With the Skeleton Crew, he battled Crossbones and Diamondback. Danny soon realized that Diamondback was his sister Rachel, and revealed who he was to her. When Crossbones returned to the Skeleton Crew, Cutthroat feared Crossbones would usurped him as chief operative, and planned to kill Crossbones in his sleep. However, worried about the outcome, Mother Night alerted Crossbones to the plan, and so Crossbones was waiting for Danny and slit Cutthroat's throat. Cutthroat was apparently killed. However, Cutthroat was later seen alive and incarcerated in the super-criminal prison The Raft, where he participated in a mass jailbreak. ===Hood's Gang=== The criminal the Hood later hired Cutthroat as part of his criminal gang. Cutthroat helped the rest of the gang battle the New Avengers, but he was defeated by Doctor Strange. As part of the Hood's gang, Cutthroat joined the fight against the Skrulls' invasion force in New York. ===Dark Reign=== Daniel was seemingly killed by Daken. However, he somehow survived, and was among the Camp H.A.M.M.E.R. troops teleported to Asgard in the Oklahoma to fight the Asgardians and the Avengers. ===Return to Hood's Gang=== Cutthroat attended a meeting of various villains organized by the Wizard to discuss what to do about Doctor Doom who had unexpectedly decided to become a superhero and become the new Iron Man. As the Hood brought up the idea of forming a gang of villains to take Doom out, Doom suddenly appeared and took down all of the villains present. Cutthroat later participated in an ambush against Doom along with many of the other villains that Doom had earlier defeated before joining Hood's Gang once more in ransacking Castle Doom in search for Doom's fortune.

daniel lewis.name: Daniel Lewis
daniel lewis.origin: Doctor Dan Lewis became the new boyfriend of Anne Weying after she broke up with Eddie Brock. When Anne was having lunch with Dr. Lewis at a high-end restaurant, Eddie barged in, run up to Anne and attempted to inform her on what was happening at Life Foundation, but his increasingly erratic behaviour and feverish temperature caused her to first assume he was drunk and then that he was sick. Eddie began wandering the restaurant and attempting to raid other people's meals, snarling at Dr. Lewis and smashing a man's nose when he tried to stop him. Dr. Lewis tried to stop the restaurant's manager from calling the police by saying that Eddie was his patient and unwell. Eddie was taken for an MRI at the hospital, where Dr. Lewis spoke to him over the PA and told him that they were going to run some tests. As the MRI started up, the symbiote negatively reacted to the high-pitched sound, causing Eddie excruciating pain. Dr. Lewis aborted the scan and walked Eddie out. Dr. Lewis told Eddie he'd call him when his test results were in and send him home. Eddie later got a phone call from Anne and Dr. Lewis, who informed him that he had a parasite. Dr. Lewis stated that the parasite was causing metabolic abnormalities and that he should get it removed as soon as possible. When Eddie came to the hospital next time, Dr. Lewis told him that the symbiote has been consuming his organs. Eddie asked if Dr. Lewis could fix the damage, but Dan said he'd never seen anything like it. Anne told Venom that it was killing Eddie, but the symbiote lashed out and attacked Dr. Lewis. Anne turned on the MRI, forcing the symbiote out of Eddie's body, and then sealed it inside the room. As Anne attempted to calm Dr. Lewis down, Venom oozed into the ventilation and bonds to a dog. Dan and Anne eventually became engaged, just as Eddie found himself in trouble again, requesting Anne's help while being questioned by the police. Anne assures Dan that there won't be any aliens involved, and presented herself as Eddie's attorney. Arriving at Mrs. Chen's store with Dr. Lewis in tow, Anne asked if she kne where Venom was only for Mrs. Chen to angrily accuse her of breaking Eddie's heart and refuse to tell them anything. A news report about Cletus Kasady and Frances Barrison came on, and Anne told Mrs. Chen that Cletus had a symbiote, to Dan's horror and outrage at his fiancée for casually lying to him. Pleased that Anne was giving it the recognition it feeld it deserved, Venom disparaged Dr. Lewis again before agreeing to help save Eddie. Arriving where Dr. Lewis was waiting for them, Venom retracted into Anne's body and refused to comply further until Eddie apologized. Addressing Dr. Lewis, Eddie advised them to leave San Francisco as quickly as possible, shaking Dr. Lewis' arm before Venom slapped him. However, before they could do that, Frances Barton incapacitated Dr. Lewis, stuffed him in the trunk of his own car, and breaked in to abduct Anne. Knocking Anne out, Frances gave Dr. Lewis a letter from Cletus saying he'd trade Anne's life for Eddie's. Dr. Lewis warned her that Venom would kill both of them, but Frances scoffed that better people than Eddie have tried and failed. Speeding down the road, Dr. Lewis called Eddie and told him that Frances and Cletus captured Anne and took her to Grace Cathedral. Dan himself showed up at the Cathedral as well and, just as Venom and Carnage were fighting, doused Carnage with burning gasoline from one of the upper floors. Hearing Carnage and Cletus screaming in pain, Frances rushed to see what was happening just as Dr. Lewis ran out of gas. The fight between the symbiotes ended in Frances falling to her death while Cletus and the Carnage symbiote were both eaten by Venom. As police reinforcements arrived, Eddie, Dr. Lewis, and Anne fled the cathedral. Anne told Venom to get Eddie as far away from San Francisco as possible. Manifesting its head, Venom tells Dr. Lewis to take care as well. At some point after Carnage's reign, Dan became the leader of the Imperium Program which focuses on capturing symbiotes.

daniel lindenbrook.name: Daniel Lindenbrook
daniel lindenbrook.origin: left|thumb|150pxDaniel Lindenbrook and his wife, Carol, were two Russian sleeper agents whose DNA had been altered by Dr. Constantin Racal's biogenetic program. When Racal visited the Lindenbrooks' home years after they had settled in the United States and started a family, including a son named Philip, he recited a nursery rhyme. The couple awoke and transformed into monstrous beings ready to do Racal's bidding.

daniel maddox.name: Daniel Maddox
daniel maddox.origin: Daniel was the unknowing stepson of a duplicate of Jamie Madrox who had renamed himself John Maddox, become a preacher, and married Daniel's mother. As John's only son, Daniel was named after John and Jamie's father. Upon learning about John's family, Jamie decided not to reabsorb him after all, leaving both Daniel and his mother to never find out what their father really was. It was later discovered that Daniel isn't John's child but from an affair Susan had with another man as the children of duplicates themselves are duplicates and would be absorbed back into John if he had fathered the child.

daniel madrox.name: Daniel Madrox
daniel madrox.origin: Daniel Madrox was the father of Jamie Madrox, who would go on to become the Multiple Man. Daniel resigned from the Los Alamos Nuclear Research Center and moved his family to an intentionally isolated farm in Lawrenceville, Kansas at the suggestion of Professor Charles Xavier. Later, Damian Tryp Sr., of Singularity Investigations, offered to look after his son Jamie, claiming that Jamie was not in fact a mutant, but a "changeling," a predecessor to mutants who develop their powers at birth. Jamie's parents, however, refused to give him to Tryp. He was killed in a tornado when Jamie was 15 . It was learned later that Tryp had created this tornado.

While flying over the Gulf of Mexico, a pilot spotted him and, realizing he was a mutant, killed him. Years later, when Emma Frost gained the power of the Phoenix, she found the man who had killed Daniel having lunch with his family and reminded him of his past crime against a young mutant, lobotomizing him in front of his family.

daniel rothstein.name: Daniel Rothstein
daniel rothstein.origin: Danny Rothstein was an accountant for S.H.I.E.L.D., handling the payroll accounting for the on-site civilian staff at Pleasant Hill. He was one of the several people being held hostage by Baron Zemo in the town hall during the assault on Pleasant Hill. When Commander Steve Rogers tried to get medical help for Maria Hill, who had been severely injured, Baron Zemo claimed that he couldn't prioritize the health of a superior over the little people, unless somebody was willing to take her place. Zemo picked Danny at random and made him choose to take Maria Hill's place. Against Hill's pleas, Rothstein accepted. He was subsequently decapitated by Zemo with a sword.

daniel shepard.name: Daniel Shepard
daniel shepard.origin: Gifted with the ability to sense other people's pain and absorb it into himself, Daniel Shepard left his hometown of Abbotsford, Ohio, and traveled east, finding those who were crushed by their pain and lifting them of their emotional burdens. Eventually, Danny arrived at Midtown High School in New York City, where he was drawn to the profound grief suffered by Peter Parker, whose uncle had recently been murdered. Danny offered to take Peter's grief away, but Parker refused, insisting that the pain would teach him to use his powers responsibly. Confounded by Parker's refusal, Danny left the school and continued traveling.
powers: Danny has the ability to and . It is unclear whether or not this effect is permanent. He also possesses some degree of telepathy.

daniel smallwood.name: Daniel Smallwood
daniel smallwood.origin: Daniel Smallwood lived with his grandparents, Tom and Gladys Smallwood. No mention of his parents is given. His grandfather operated a fishing trawler and discovered a strange object. Young Daniel was sure it was an egg; when Gladys broke it open, there was a tiny infant female in it. While she may have been physically different than most, Marrina, was welcomed into the Smallwood family and she and Dan grew very close. She matured at an accelerated rate. She and Dan were close friends and when she displayed her superhuman powers, it was he who suggested she report herself to the Ministry of Defence. Unknown to most Dan felt a love for her more than that of a boy for his childhood friend, but Marrina married another, Namor.

daniel sylva.name: Daniel Sylva
daniel sylva.first_appearance: Dead of Night Featuring Devil-Slayer Vol 1 1
daniel sylva.origin: After his second tour in Iraq, Sergeant Danny Sylva had problems with his girlfriend who eventually left him and he couldn't find a job so he went for a third tour, now not caring to return alive. He described Iraq as a yellowish brown spot on Earth with everything on it dying. After a soldier named Wahl disappeared, Danny's team got a lead on him. Suddenly they walked into an ambush and all excluding Danny were killed. Danny found Wahl, strung up by his ankles with his throat cut while demons feed upon the human bodies and their leader was his uncle's old enemy, Belathauzer. He was rescued by Isaac Kaufmann and his assistant, Gabir, who told him he's the next Shagish Chultepi. Kaufman died from serious injuries and Gabir escorted Danny to a cave where the Devil-Slayer apparatus are hidden. When getting out they confronted an army of zombies and Danny succeeded in slashing them all. The mercenary group led by Belathauzer, Bloodstone, warned the U.S. Army base that Danny had killed all his soldiers and was now a deserter. When he heard this, he phoned his captain, but he didn't believe him. Suddenly the mercenary attacked their safehouse and killed Gabir, though Danny escaped.
powers: Able to use the Sword of Naram-Sin and wear Shemagh. Other mysterious powers of Shagish Chultepi.
abilities: Army training.
weapons: He's equipped with the Sword of Naram-Sin and other military weapons like guns, knifes, sniper rifles, bombs and some heavy artillery.

daniel wiley.name: Daniel Wiley
daniel wiley.first_appearance: Uncanny X-Men at the State Fair of Texas Vol 1 1
daniel wiley.origin: Danny Wiley's father worked as a government scientist before he had an accident in his lab; subsequently, he retired to raise horses in Texas. Danny was born a mutant and grew up tending to the horses, which he felt an unusual kinship toward, and who he would often run with in his mutant form. Danny would take the horses to be shown at the Texas State Fair, and on one such occasion he was detected by both Magneto's and Professor Xavier's mutant-locating hardware. Magneto arrived at the fair fist and dubbed Danny "Eques," the latest soldier in his crusade. Upon the arrival of the X-Men, Magneto convinced Danny that they were villains there to kidnap him, and so he took on his mutant form and fought alongside Magneto against them. When Magneto carelessly injured Danny's horses, however, Danny turned against him and with the aid of the X-Men, defeated him in battle. Danny elected to stay in Texas, although the X-Men left him with a card for the Xavier Institute.
powers: Danny was a metamorph able to transform his body into an equine state with horselike speed that resembled a winged centuar. While in this state, he possessed both flight and horselike speed.

danielle belmonde.origin: The daughter of Raymonde Belmonde, Danielle made an alliance with the criminal Deadly Ernest in an attempt to help Ernest take over her father's business. danielle blunt.name: Danielle Blunt
danielle blunt.species: Human mutated by overexposure to electromagnetic radiation
danielle blunt.origin: Danielle Blunt, like the other members of the Bastards of Evil, was kidnapped by the Superior and exposed to electromagnetic radiation, in the process giving her incredible superpowers. She was also subjected to 'personal narrative implants', causing false memories. Among these, she was led to believe that she had recently discovered that her true father was the supervillain Electro. Taking on the codename of "Aftershock", she joined the the Bastards of Evil, believing in their mission of spreading wanton, purposeless destruction and terror. She was appointed to the post of field leader by the Superior, and showed a particular passion for villainy. She and Singularity regularly butted heads for the role of leader, eventually leading to her running through Singularity, which caused his true memories to be restored. Aftershock, along with the remaining members of the Bastards of Evil, is currently being held in prison. She learned, both from Spider-Girl and Singularity's restored memories, about her true identity. It appears that learning her true origin didn't change her ways as she returned to the life of evil.

danielle bock.origin: Daniell Bock was led out of Poland during 1939 with the first invasion of the Nazis by the corpse of her father, Dr. Simon Bock, who had been possessed by the spirit of John Kowalski. Danielle nor the rest of her family knew the truth even after John used the corpse to sacrifice itself to kill Maj. Rudolph Kreutzmann. Not much is know of Danielle after the events of her family's departure of Poland but it can be assumed she married her fiancé Mitchell Townshend, an American diplomat who helped her and her family escape to the United States of America as refugees.

Trevani and H.E.A.R.T. were hired again to attack Ghost Rider by the demon Deathwatch, but they eventually ended their ties with Deathwatch after learning that he was a villain. Trevani and most of H.E.A.R.T. were killed by the Firm after they attacked their headquarters.

danilo rojas.name: Danilo Rojas
danilo rojas.origin: Danilo Rojas was a military officer in the Colombian army. Believing the Terrigen Cloud spread throughout the globe to be a gift from God meant to help man purge Mutants, Rojas and his men began to massacre the sick Mutant population in the country. He disappeared before he could be arrested for his crimes, having stationed at an abandoned military base in Ecuador. thumb|left The Mutant mercenary Domino became aware of Rojas' whereabouts, anonymously leaked an encrypted comm log into the internal network of Bobby Da Costa's A.I.M. so he could find out his location, and subsequently positioned herself in Ecuador so Bobby would contact her to take care of Rojas as a favor. Domino would use the favor to make Bobby forgive a debt of hers. After infiltrating Rojas' facility and killing his forty-two assets, Domino was confronted by Rojas just as she ran out of bullets. danny bartlett.name: Danny Bartlett
danny bartlett.origin: Danny Bartlett was a small-time crook and all he was looking for in his life was to make a lot of money, sometimes even risking going to prison for a long time for his crimes. One day he met a man who offered him two million dollars if he would agree to marry his beautiful daughter. Initially skeptical, thinking it was a joke, the man, whose name was Ebenezer Wellington, eventually managed to convince him. Danny agreed and he and Wellington agreed on a wedding day and venue, to which he was to appear in suitable attire and with the understanding that he would not see the bride until the wedding day. Once the fateful day arrived, Danny went to the appointed place after having a suitable dress made by a tailor, even if the dress seemed more appropriate for a funeral than a wedding, and once there he was welcomed by Ebenezer alongside his betrothed, who turned out to be a girl embalmed in a coffin, and given the situation Danny asked what would become of the promised 2 million, but Ebenezer replied to him what he would do with the money and that he would never leave that place and immediately plunged a embalming needle in the terrified Danny.

Mitch planned to flee to California but before he could the cabin was covered by an avalanche. danny camino.name: Danny Camino
danny camino.origin: Danny Camino was the son of industrialist Lee Camino, owner of Sterling Motors. Danny discovered from a document that his father had signed a contract with Executive Services, Inc., a company that lent money to industrialists, expecting a percentage of the profits. The contracts had stringent clauses; Camino's clause required him to hand over his son Danny to ESI and have him killed by Headhunter. Camino told his son not to take the clause seriously, but when he became insolvent, Danny was kidnapped. Spider-Man helped Camino, preventing Headhunter from killing him and thus rescuing his son Danny, who was being held prisoner by Headhunter in the ESI basement. Headhunter set traps in ESI's basement, but Spider-Man overcame the traps and knocked Headhunter out with a punch, revealing all the heads Headhunter had decapitated, stored in glass containers. Headhunter was arrested, while the ESI executives fled in a helicopter, dismissing the incident as a simple mishap. Once the ESI crisis was over, Camino began to adopt a softer business strategy, putting the family first.

danny poll.name: Danny Poll
danny poll.origin: In the year 1927, Private Danny Poll became jealous of his superior officer Lieutenant Callen due to their rivaling affections for a girl name Marie. Not liking being spoken down to by a low ranking officer, Callen started a fight. Mad with rage, Poll attempted to bash Callen's brains out with a rock, but the two were pulled apart by other military staff. For attempting to kill his superior officer, Poll was court-martialed and was spared the firing squad due to the fact that they were not in a war. Instead, Poll was sentenced to 15 years in solitary confinement. As Danny rotted in prison, he vowed to get revenge unaware that Callen married Marie, and the two actually attempted to get Danny freed from prison but were unsuccessful due to the red tape. Danny was freed in the fall of 1942 and began thinking up how to get revenge against Callen for putting him behind bars. Unable to get the idea of a firing squad out of his head, Danny spotted a bank robbery in progress and noted the mobsters' sloppy execution. Thinking he could train the crooks to be more efficient, Danny jumped on the back of their vehicle and rode to their farmhouse hideout. There, Danny found that one of the mobsters carelessly left his tommy gun in the car. Entering the house, he overheard an altercation brewing between the mobsters and their boss who insisted on taking 50% of their haul even though he did nothing on the job. Danny burst in and shot the mob leader dead, then made the gang an offer they could not refuse: Let him give them military training to make them more efficient, and he will split all of their ill gotten gains evenly. The mobsters accepted the offer and the Firing Squad was born. After extensive training and creating their own uniforms, the Firing Squad robbed a bank. They were opposed by the Angel, but they managed to escape. However, Danny managed to accidentally drop his wallet at the scene of the crime. The Angel used this to track Danny down to his room at the Hotel Regent. There, the hero clashed with the Firing Squad but was tossed out of the 10th floor window of the hotel room. Danny then began plotting his next scheme: This one targeting Callen (now a Major) who recently inherited his family's fortune. Knowing that Callen now had a son, he intended to kidnap the boy for ransom and then murder Callen when the ransom was paid. Unaware that the Angel had survived and overheard this, the Firing Squad had to face the hero and the police at the Callen home. During the fight, Danny was confronted by Marie, and this reunion -- plus the realization that she had married Callen and birthed the child he had come to kidnap -- distracted Danny enough to be captured by the authorities but the rest of his mob managed to escape. When Danny was brought to court, the rest of the Firing Squad stormed the court house and freed their leader. They also managed to capture Cullen's son and make a clean getaway. They later sent a ransom note demanding that they get paid $50,000 for the safe release of the Callen child, the money to be delivered to their farmhouse by Callen himself. There, Callen was put through a mock trial and "sentenced" to death by firing squad. However, before they could execute Callen, the Angel once more intervened. During the fight, the police arrived with Marie, and while the Angel sent Callen and his son to safety, Marie confronted Danny. When Danny attempted to shoot Callen, Marie stood in the way of his bullets and was fatally wounded instead. Realizing the horrible mistake he had made, Danny then walked into the cross fire between his gang and the police and was mowed down. The Angel then helped the authorities round up the rest of the gang, who crumbled easily with their leader now dead.

danny summers.name: Danny Summers
danny summers.origin: Danny Summers was a wealthy friend of Frank Drake. When Drake squandered his personal fortune, he went to Danny to attempt to get a loan, which Danny flatly refused. This last refusal of a loan led Frank Drake to attempt to cash in his ownership of Castle Dracula, which brought a return of Dracula, and plunged Drake into a quest to destroy his age old ancestor. A few years later after fighting alongside Quincy Harker's vampire hunters and forming a romance with Rachel van Helsing, Frank needed time away to rediscover who he was during a time that the hunters thought Dracula to be dead. Frank contacted his old friend Danny who offered him a job working for his new company Summers Inc. which was involved in a government dig in Brazil. Danny took Frank to the site of his most recent dig, and Frank eventually learned that all its workers were really zombies. As it turned out, Danny had been hired by Dracula to eliminate Frank Drake. Frank escaped his deathtrap with the aid of Brother Voodoo. After defeating the zombies, Brother Voodoo revealed to Frank that Danny Summers was responsible for summoning the zombies. Tracking Danny down, Frank punched him out and demanded to know who it was that hired Danny to try and murder him. Danny revealed that Dracula was his employer and that he had no choice because the vampire lord put him under a hypnotic spell. Although Frank was reluctant to believe Danny, he let him go anyway.

dansen macabre.name: Dansen Macabre
dansen macabre.origin: ===Cult of Kali=== A member of the Cult of Kali, a Nepalese cult that studied martial arts and mystical disciplines, Dansen Macabre hypnotized Spider-Man into battling the Shroud for her, hoping to kill him as punishment for running away from the cult temple and his devotion to fighting crime. The Shroud managed to shake Spider-Man from his trance, and they defeated her together. She was later captured by the criminal, Locksmith, who was embarking on a plan to capture superhuman beings and keep them imprisoned so that regular humans could be free to strive and achieve without being overshadowed. The Locksmith had also captured Spider-Woman, who managed to escape, defeat Locksmith, and free the prisoners she trusted. Dansen Macabre (and the other criminal prisoners) were turned over to the police. Shortly after the Secret Wars, the Venom symbiote made its way to the Club Venom nightclub, where an eyeless Deadpool battled X-51 and a group of cyborg cultists under the thrall of Dansen Macabre, the leader of the Mech-Lords of Hell sect of the Cult of Kali. Despite being blind, Deadpool was able to kill some of the cultists, but was disarmed and restrained by X-51. Deadpool's eyes began to regenerate, but just as he began to succumb to Dansen Macabre's mind-control, the symbiote bonded to him. Sprouting a fanged mouth, Deadpool slammed X-51 to the ground and threatened to eat his brains, which X-51 urged him to do so that he would no longer be a threat. Deadpool regained control of himself, knocked X-51 out, and used the symbiote's tentacles to wield multiple guns and swords simultaniously. Killing several cultists, he discovered that the symbiote could shoot webbing like Spider-Man, and used it to restrain Dansen Macabre and the remaining cultists. ===Night Shift=== At some point, Dansen Macabre was contacted by the Shroud to join his team of criminals called the Night Shift, the circumstances of which remain unrevealed. Macabre was elected as deputy leader of the group and often led the team in criminal endeavors when the Shroud was absent, such as leading an attack on the West Coast Avengers in revenge for capturing the Night Shift member, Digger. In this encounter, Dansen Macabre was defeated by the Scarlet Witch. Eventually, the Night Shift mutinied against the Shroud's leadership, and came under the sway of the Hangman and Satannish. Dansen Macabre later became a member of Superia's all-female team of supervillains, the Femizons. Macabre worked with the Night Shift again to join forces with the Hood in a fight against the Midnight Sons. In the fight, she quickly overpowered Jennifer Kale, who called her a skank for dancing and fighting naked. Macabre was briefly out of the fight, however, when Morbius attacked and bit her. When she meant to retaliate, an airborne virus turned her and the rest of Night Shift into zombies. They were then under the control of Dormammu, who ordered them to keep attacking the Midnight Sons. While the Midnight Sons managed to stop Dormammu's plans, the Hood was thankful and teleported away with the Night Shift. Macabre next appeared in Paris, somehow dezombified, attempting to put the entire city under trance, when she was stopped by the Mighty Avengers. thumb Dansen, as part of Night Shift, was hired by Snapdragon to take down Moon Knight, and failing to, was killed along with most of the rest of the Night Shift by the LA Kingpin. ===Superior Spider-Man=== Macabre was seen alive again with a new Night Shift team in San Francisco. They attempted to rob a bus full of people when they were stopped by the Superior Octopus. He quickly overpowered the team, but instead of arresting them made them the offer to become his henchmen, as he was new to the city. The group accepted and Octavius swung away. Together with Digger and Octavius, who now went by Superior Spider-Man, she stopped a new cult from resurrecting their dead master. After using her hypnotic dance to make them go to the police, Macabre asked Octavius out for dinner, which he rejected on grounds of professionalism. Night Shift later attempted to help Octavius battle Terrax, but quickly disappeared when they realized he was out of their weight-class.

danton vayla.name: Danton Vayla
danton vayla.origin: Danton Vayla was the leader of a high-profile satanic cult called the Brotherhood of Baal in Los Angeles. He and his followers believed that soul transmigration was possible, meaning that a person's soul could be transferred from one body to another. Lissa Russell joined the cult hoping to find a cure for her brother, Jack's, lycanthropy. News of the cult's idea of soul transmigration even reached as far East as New York City, where it reached the ears of the wandering Frankenstein's Monster. Tired of being regarded as a monster and having to roam the world alone, the creature hid himself aboard a cargo train in a New York trainyard that was bound for Los Angeles, hoping the cult could help him. Before he arrived in L.A., however, he was discovered on the train and was forced to crash through the side of the train car, not realizing that the train was overlooking a giant cliff aside the Pacific Ocean. The train security believed that no one could survive such a fall, but members of the Brotherhood of Baal discovered the behemoth roaming the beaches and followed them to their leader. Vayla understood what it was the monster wanted, a normal form and a normal existence, and promised to provide it to him. Meanwhile, Lissa had come to the conclusion that the cult were nothing more than a bunch of crackpots and quit, going home to her step-father's house. Vayla, however, decided to make an example of her and any others whose belief wavered. It was she that was decided upon as the sacrifice needed for the cult's soul transmigration to take place. When Jack arrived at his step-father's home, he saw that it had been ransacked and soon realized that the cult had kidnapped his sister. After discovering the cult's location, Jack drove to save her, not caring that night was coming on and it was the time of the full moon. As Jack transformed, his car went off the road and the Werewolf fled into the forest, coincidently heading in the same direction as the cult's headquarters. The Werewolf crashed into the headquarters and attacked the cult's members. The Frankenstein's monster came to their aid, believing this to be his one chance to live a normal life. After a bloody battle, Frankenstein's Monster knocked the Werewolf unconscious, and when he awoke he found himself the new sacrificial victim for the cult's spell. Just before Vayla could sacrifice the Werewolf, however, he told of the ritual's real purpose, to allow Satan to inhabit the body of the Frankenstein's Monster, not thinking that the monster would understand him. Vayla proved to be mistaken as the Monster grabbed the knife from his hands and threw him against a large inverted cross on the wall, which crashed on top of him, killing him. The rest of the cult met a similar end as the Monster and the Werewolf fought together, eventually causing the place to catch aflame. The seaside property soon toppled into the sea, effectively ending the threat of the cult.
weapons: A large knife

daphne.name: Daphne
daphne.origin: Daphne was a minor nature deity among the Olympian pantheon. In ancient history, she was pursued by Apollo. She fled him and in order to escape begged the gods for help, who in turn transformed her into a laurel tree. Eventually restored to humanoid form once more, Daphne came to reside on Olympus. When Olympus was moved to the planet Venus, she lived there as well. In 1949, Zeus (then calling himself under his Roman named of Jupiter) returned from a leave of absence. Noticing that Aphrodite (then calling herself Venus) had abandoned the Olympians to live among the mortals of Earth became furious. He attempted to force her to return to Olympus, but agreed to a challenge: Venus had to find a mortal couple with everlasting love within a week or be forced to return to Olympus. Venus found this in the couple Meg Saunder and Danny Lane who were scheduled to be married in a week. Seeking to prevent the couple from being broken apart by the machinations of Jupiter, she took them on a vacation to Hollywood as Jupiter despised actors. Jupiter instead sent Apollo and Daphne to Earth, having them disguise themselves as wealthy mortals Renee Andre and Rona Belladonna. As "Rona Belladonna", Daphne attempted to seduce Danny, but her attempts to do so did not begin to work until both she and Apollo framed Meg for "Renee's" murder. However, before Daphne could use her charm on Danny and make him kiss her, Venus appeared and used her godly powers to force Daphne to reveal Jupiter's plan and also forced Apollo to reveal that he was never really dead. With Meg and Danny married, Daphne and Apollo were returned to Olympus and Jupiter allowed Venus to stay on Earth.

daphne plepler.name: Daphne Plepler
daphne plepler.origin: Daphne Plepler started dating the necromancer Michael Hawthorne after meeting through a social network for people interested in magic called "Magic Mingle." After an on-and-off relationship, the two became a formal couple. She eventually became pregnant by Michael and the two were expecting a child. On the day Daphne and Michael were going to reveal the former's pregnancy to her parents, Michael's friend and ally Deadpool abruptly interrupted their lunch with her parents and took Michael to have him help in a supernatural emergency in Monster Metropolis, which was being attacked by the magic-siphoning army known as the Empirikul. Michael died during the conflict, sacrificing his life when casting a spell that saved the entire city. Later that night, Deadpool visited Daphne in her apartment to inform her of the tragedy. She broke down in tears, and in a fit of rage blamed Deadpool for killing Michael and orphaning their unborn child.

dara ko eke.name: Dara Ko Eke
dara ko eke.origin: ===Origins=== Dara Ko Eke was a Badoon Moord, an offshoot created by the Kree. She went through Amphogenesis, the process that grants her people powers. Obtaining psionic abilities, she was called "All-Knowing". ===Universal Inhumans and Light Brigade=== She became a member of the Light Brigade among the Universal Inhumans. The Brigade were sent through Eldrac to the Negative Zone to participate in a great challenge of their abilities. The team was captured by Arthrosians in Negative Zone, and Annihilus made them fight on the arena to the death against the Arthrosian champions. After that, Johnny opened a portal to the Baxter Building and they all returned to Earth. Along with the Universal Inhumans, Dara relocated to the great city of Novahala, on the continent of Akuunos of the planet Centauri-IV. Dara also seemingly stopped using her Inhuman name, "the All-Knowing", going by her birth name. Their village became terrorized by Saarl the Slaughterer (who forced them to fight in gladiator-style combats for his entertainment, thus forcing them to compromise on their vow), one of the Badoon's Swamp Gods. To help her, Loki took the form of Captain Marvel and enlisted the help of Echo (Maya Lopez) (pretending Dara was asking for help). Despite being unannounced and assaulted by Badoon at first, Echo was welcomed by Dara. Exchanging on their respective paths, Dara offered the troubled Echo the use of her psychic powers to see her future, but saw only fire. The next morning, Echo and the Badoon went to Saarl, and Echo easily defeated him. Rather than slaying him, she put his fate in the Badoon's hands. Despite Dara's proposition to stay among them for a while, Echo was now ready to deal with her own unfinished business, as planned by Loki.

daraxus dax.name: Daraxus Dax
daraxus dax.origin: An alien on a world targeted by the giant bullet that Kitty Pryde was briefly stuck inside. Not knowing the bullet was in a phased state, the planet's populace was told they had five years before impact. Descending into chaos, the world erupted in anarchy. While many of the rich managed to leave the planet in spaceships, those who couldn't afford it were left with their seeming end drawing near. During this chaos, Daraxus killed a random individual, an act he came to regret, leaving his fruit ration outside the door of a neighbor's apartment as a way of paying penance. As the bullet drew near, Daraxus was one many who stood on the planet's surface, wanting to face destruction head-on. As the bullet drew near, his neighbor approached him, informing him that she knew what he had been doing, and as the world's end came about...and both were equally shocked when the bullet passed through their world, giving them a second chance at life.

darby dean.name: Darby Dean
darby dean.origin: Susan and Darby Dean were a happily married couple who were also anti-mutant activists. When they learned that one of their two unborn twin daughters would be a mutant, they agreed to terminate the mutant fetus. The procedure was halted, but not before the mutant fetus was seemingly destroyed. However, the fetus was revealed to have been transferred to another dimension by its sister, Laura, who was also a mutant. Laura grew up being considered autistic, communicating rarely with the world. Her parents, in an effort to help her, sent her to the New Life Clinic in Vancouver, British Columbia. However, while there, Laura was drafted into the Derangers, after which she joined Beta Flight. The deans were apparently unaware of their daughter's location and activities. When Alpha Flight was put on trial, news footage aired internationally by the media showed the Deans their daughter fighting alongside the team. They later pursued this lead to Ottawa, shortly after Laura was injured by Wild Child. They offered her a blood transfusion and to take her home when they learned that Heather Hudson, leader of Alpha Flight, intended to file for custody of Laura and her sister Goblyn. While visiting Laura, she suddenly woke up and transported the Deans and Beta Flight to Liveworld to save Goblyn from the Dreamqueen. Upon their eventual return to Earth, the Deans left their daughters in the care of Alpha Flight and have not been heard from since.

dargil.name: Dargil
dargil.origin: Dargil was a servant of the much more powerful demon Mephisto who was sent to investigate the disappearance of a soul forsworn to Mephisto by its owner. When Dargil arrived, the owner was prepared, and cut off his head, affixing it to a chain, making him his servant. That owner had sealed his soul in brass armor and taken the moniker, the Brass Bishop. Dargil served the Bishop for many years, taking and sucking the souls out of whomever the Bishop wanted and feeding it to him. When the Bishop needed Puck to find the Solomon Seal, a mystical key which could open the gates to heaven, Dargil sucked out his soul, into the Brass Bishop, turning Puck into a mindless drone, obedient to the Bishop. However, Puck was able to free himself enough to use the Seal on the Bishop, freeing his soul for Mephisto to take back to his dimension. Presumably, Dargil also returned to Mephisto's dimension.
